sa: अहं चापि प्रतिज्ञां तां गुरोः समनुपालयन्। वनमद्यैव यास्यामि स्थिरीभव मनस्विनि॥
en: To day shall I repair to the forest for redeeming my father's vows; do you, Oh high minded one, live here in undisturbed mind.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तथा तेन वसिष्ठो जपतां वरः। आजुहाव ततः प्रीतः कल्माषीं धूतकल्मषाम्॥
en: This having been said by him, Vasistha, the best of those reciting mantras, joyfully called his sacrificial dappled cow, capable of purging away sins.

sa: कृत्वावहारं सैन्यानां प्रविश्य शिबिरं स्वकम्। कुरवः सुहितं मन्त्रं मन्त्रयाञ्चक्रिरे मिथः॥
en: Thereupon having drawn the troops and entered into their own encampment, the sons of Kuru held a consultation among themselves for their own welfare.

sa: एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच त्र्यम्बकं वरदं प्रभुम्।
en: Being thus addressed, he (Bhargava) replied to that boon-giving and three-eyed Lord.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा वचनं कुर्वन् वासुदेवस्य पाण्डवः। ततः क्षुरप्रं निशितं गाण्डीवे समायोजयत्॥
en: Having thus spoken and desirous of carrying out the words of Vasudeva, the son of Pandu placed a sharp razor-headed arrows on the bowstring.

sa: पश्य सिन्धुपतिं वीरं प्रेक्षमाणं दिवाकरम्॥ भयं हि विप्रमुच्यैतत् त्वत्तो भरतसत्तम।
en: Beholding, O foremost of the Bharatas, the heroic ruler of the Sindhus looked at the sun, freed from the fear he entertained to you.

sa: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्॥ तत उचुक्रुशुः सर्वे हतः पार्थ इति स्म हो ततः शङ्खनिनादाश्च भेरीशब्दाश्च पुष्कलाः॥ नानावादिनानिनदाः सिंहनादाश्च जज्ञिरे।
en: Deeply wounded and felling great pain Arjuna sunk down on the terrace of his car. Then all the soldiers cried aloud Partha is killed. Then there arose the blare of conch, the profuse sound of bugles and many other musical instruments and the leonine roars of the warriors.

sa: शपेऽऽत्मनां शैनेय सत्येन तपसा तथा। अहत्वा सर्वपाञ्चालान् यदि शान्तिमहं लभे॥
en: By my truth and by my ascetic austerities, I swear before you, that I shall enjoy no rest without slaying the whole Panchalas race.

sa: तं सूतपुत्रं रथिनां वरिष्ठं निष्कालिकं कालवशं नयाद्य। तं सूतपुत्रं रथिनां वरिष्ठं हत्वा प्रीति धर्मराजे कुरुष्व॥
en: The son of a charioteer (Karna), the best chariot fighter thinks himself beyond the reach of Yama. Enslave him to Yama today. Kill Karna, the son of a charioteer today for the pleasure of Dharamraja, Yudhishthira.

sa: तां महास्त्रमयीं वृष्टिं संछिद्य शरवृष्टिभिः॥ न्यवधीच ततो योधान् वासविः परवीरहा।
en: Cutting off with his own arrows the brightly weapons showered on him, Vasava's son, the slayer of hostile heroes, began to kill those warriors.

sa: हत्वा जित्वा च गन्धर्वाचित्रसेनमुखान् रणे। कर्ण दुर्योधनं पार्थं सभार्यं सममोक्षयत्॥
en: Having defeated in battle the Gandharvas led by Chitrasena with a great slaughter it was Arjuna, O Karna, who rescued Duryodhana with his wife.

sa: संग्रामाणां हि धर्मज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः। न चाधर्ममहं कुर्या जानंश्चैव हि मुह्यसे॥
en: So, it is impossible that I should commit a sinful act. Knowing this also, fight with their foes, being supported by their own men.

sa: शैनेयस्तव पुत्रं तु हत्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः॥ धनुश्चास्य रणे छित्त्वा विस्मयन्नर्जुनं ययौ।
en: Thereupon the grandson of Sini wounding your son with five swift-coursing arrows cutoff the latter's bow and then smiling a little proceeded towards Arjuna.

sa: निवार्य सेनां महतीं हत्वा शूरांश्च पार्थिवान्॥ निहतः सैन्धवो राजा त्वयास्त्रबलतेजसा।
en: Having thwarted the vast host and slain numerous valiant kings you, with the strength of your weapons, have slain the ruler of the Sindhus.

sa: तमायान्तं प्रहेष्वासं दृष्ट्वा भूतानि भारत। निहतं मेनिरे कर्णं पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥
en: O Bharata, seeing that great archer start off for the field all the living beings believed Karna as already slain by the magnanimous Pandava.

sa: अथ कोशाद् विनिष्कृष्य खङ्गं भूरिश्रवा रणे। मूर्धजेषु निजग्राह पदा चोरस्यताडयत्॥
en: Then drawing his sword out of the scabbard and holding Satyaki by the hair, Bhurisravas struck the former on the breast with his legs.

sa: ततः शक्तिं गृहीत्वा तु रुक्मदण्डामयस्मयीम्। तरसा प्रेषयामास माधवस्य रथं प्रति॥
en: Then taking up a lance of golden staff and iron-head, Drona hurled it vchemently at the car of that descendant of Madhu's race (Satyaki).

sa: यूपकेतो निरीक्ष्यैतन्न मामर्हसि गर्हितुम्। न हि धर्ममविज्ञाय युक्तं गर्हयितुं परम्॥
en: Knowing this, O stake-bannered, one it befits you not to reproach me; without yourself knowing the rules of morality, you should not censure others.

sa: राधेयो भीममानछेद् युद्धाय भरतर्षभ यथा नागो वने मार्ग मत्तो मत्तमभिद्रवन्॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, Radha's son advanced against Bhima for battle, like one infuriate elephant rushing against a compeer in the same state.

sa: बालेनापि सता तेन कृतं साह्यं जनार्दन। असहेतोर्गतं ज्ञात्वा पाण्डवं श्वेतवाहनम्॥
en: Although then a small boy only, did us many good turns, O Jannarddana. Being informed that Pandu's son Arjuna had gone to acquire weapons.

sa: उद्यम्य त्वरितो बाहुं ब्रुवाणश्च पुनः पुनः। जीवन्तमानयाचार्य मा वधीरिति धर्मवित्॥
en: "Bring the preceptor alive; conversant with the rules of fair fight, you should not slay aim." Although thus prevented by the Kauravas and Arjuna.

sa: यश्च विक्षोभ्य महतीं सेनामालोड्य चासकृत्। एकः प्रविष्टः संक्रुद्धो नलिनीमिव कुञ्जरः॥
en: He that had single-handed and unsupported entered into and agitated my army, even as an infuriate elephant enters and crushes a group of lotuses.

sa: षभिः सूतं त्रिभिः केतुं पुनस्तं चापि सप्तभिः। भीमसेनोऽपि संक्रुद्धः साश्वयन्तारमाशुगैः॥
en: Thereat excited with wrath, Bhima dispatched Durjaya, his horses and steeds to the abode of Death, piercing them to the vitals with his arrows.

sa: अधर्मस्त्वेष सुमहाननार्चचरितं च तत्। नारिं जित्वातिकत्यन्ते न च जल्पन्ति दुर्वचः॥
en: Men, that are heroic, virtuous and most exalted, having defeated an enemy, neither! boast of themselves with harsh words, nor indulge in abusive language.

sa: तस्मिन् विनिहते वीरे त्रैगर्तानां महारथे। बलं तेऽभज्यत विभो पाण्डवेयैः समन्ततः॥
en: When that heroic and mighty car-warrior of the Trigarttas had been slain, O master, your army was completely broken and routed by the Pandavas.

sa: वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। संक्षये जगतस्तीने युगान्त इव भारत॥
en: When, 0 Bharata, that fierce fierce and horripilating battle was raging furiously, it appeared that the hour of the world's dreadful dissolution had arrived.

sa: ततः प्रभाते विमले स्थिता दिष्टस्य शासने। चक्रुरावश्यकं सर्वे विधिद्दष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: Thereupon at the break of day they, being obedient to the injunctions of ordinance, all performed the necessary ceremonies, prescribed by the established usage.

sa: कृष्णानां श्वेतवत्सानां सहस्राणि चतुर्दश। आहरं न लभे तस्मात् प्रसाद द्विजसत्तमात्॥
en: Offering him then full fourteen thousand black kine each with a white calf I could not obtain the grace of that best of Brahmanas.

sa: तादृग् रूपं कृतमिदं मम कार्यं सुहृत्तमैः। मोहाल्लब्धस्य पापस्य जिह्मस्य धनमीहतः॥
en: Covetous, sinful, crooked-minded and greedy of riches that I am, this affair of mine has been managed in this way by (so-called) best friend.

sa: एते चान्ये च राजानो देवैरपि सुदुर्जयाः॥ निहताः समरे शूराः पाण्डवैर्बलवत्तराः।
en: These and numerous other heroes difficult of be being vanquished by the very gods and more powerful than the Pandavas themselveslie slain in battle.

sa: भूय एव तु विंशत्या सायकानां समाचिनोत्। साश्वसूतध्वजं द्रोणः पश्यतां सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: Then once more, with twenty shafts, Drona pierced him and his steeds, charioteer and standards, before the very eyes of all the bowmen present.

sa: त एते मन्ति नस्तात विशिखा: पार्थचोदिताः। तांस्तदाऽऽख्यायमानस्त्वं विदुरेण च बुद्धवान्॥
en: Those arrows, O child, now discharged by aya are destroying us; you did not then understand when Vidura told you what those (dice) were.

sa: अवप्लुत्य रथाचापि त्वरितः स महारथः। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं भारद्वाजस्य मारिष॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior, jumping down from his chariot with quickness, O sire, ascended with agility upon the car of the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: सूदान् भृत्यजनान् दासांस्त्वं गृहे त्वरयन् भृशम्। योग्यस्ताडयितुं क्रोधाद् भोजनार्थ वृकोदर॥
en: Urging cooks and servants and orderlies to make haste in making your dinner ready, O Vrikodara, you are capable of striking and reproving them.

sa: गीर्यमाणः च कृष्णेन पार्थेन च महात्मना। भीमेन चक्ररक्षाभ्यामश्वत्थाम्ना कृपेण च॥
en: And although forbidden by the high-souled Partha and Krishna and Bhima and the two wheel protectors of of Arjuna's car and Ashvattharnan and Kripa.

sa: येन साक्षान्महादेवो योधितः समरे पुरा। तमिच्छसि वृथा जेतुं सूताधम मनोरथैः॥
en: O wretch of a charioteer, you are in vain hoping in your mind to conquer him, who formerly fought with the very Mahadeva himself.

sa: चक्ररक्षौ तु पार्थस्य माद्रीपुत्रौ परंतपौ। तावप्यधावतां कर्ण राजानं मा वधीरिति॥
en: The two sons of Madri protected the sides of Yudhishthira and then they ran towards Karna so that he might not kill the king.

sa: तामाशां विफलीकृत्य संतीर्णौ तौ परंतपौ। द्रोणानीकं महाराज भोजानीकं च दुस्तरम्॥
en: Falsifying that hope of theirs, those two scorchers of foes, succeeded in crossing over the uncrossable division of Drona and the Bhojas, O king.

sa: वाजिनश्च हतारोहा: पत्तयश्च गतासवः॥ शेरते युधि निर्भिन्ना वमन्तो रुधिरं बहु।
en: Many horses also, with their riders slain and many of the infantries lay down dead pierced with arrows and vomiting blood and bleeding profusely.

sa: स्वसारथिमुवाचेदं द्रोणानीकाय मा वह। सोऽपि तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विशोकोऽवाहयद्धयान्॥ ४९
en: Ordered his own charioteer to take him towards Drona's troops. Visaka (the charioteer of Bhima), hearing those words of his (master) guided the steeds.

sa: योऽवमन्य वचः पथ्यं सुहृदामाप्तकारिणाम्। स्वमतं कुरुते मूढः स शोच्यो नचिरादिव॥
en: That stupid person, who disregarding the wholesome advice of his trusted friends, follows his own inclinations, is very soon reduced to a pitiable plight.

sa: पश्य राधेय पृथ्वीशान् पृथिव्यां पातितान् बहून्। पार्थेन निहतान् संख्ये महेन्द्रोपमविक्रमान्॥
en: Penetrate through that impenetrable array in battle when the latter was trying (to resist him). Indeed Phalguna is exceedingly dear to the high-souled preceptor.

sa: एष वैकर्तनः कर्णो हैडिम्बेन समागतः। कुरुते कर्म सुमहद् यदस्यौपयिकं मृधे॥
en: "Yonder is Vikartana's son Karna engaged in battle with the son of Hidimba. Behold he is achieving feats worthy of his valour and strength.

sa: नापितंश्च ततो भूत्वा पुनर्भवति ब्राह्मणः। द्विजो भूत्वा च तत्रैव पुनर्दासोऽभिजायते॥
en: Having become a barber he will again become a Brahmana. Attaining again to the position of a Brahmana he will again become a slave.

sa: कर्णमभ्यर्दितं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुपुत्रेण मारिष। विस्मयं परमं जम्मू रथिनः सह दैवतैः॥
en: O sire, seeing, Karna thus crushed by the son of Pandu, all the car-warriors, along with the celestials, obtained the highest condition of astonishment.

sa: ते हया बह्वशोभन्त मिश्रिता वारंहसः। सितासिता महारात यथा व्योम्नि बलाहकाः॥
en: Those horses, fleet as the winds, thus mingled together looked exceedingly beautiful like white and black clouds, O king, mingled together in the firmament.

sa: यथा मृगगणांस्त्रस्तान सिंहो द्रावयते दिशः॥ पञ्चालानां रथवातान् कर्णो व्यद्रावयत् तथा।
en: As a lion drives away a herd of timid deer in all directions, so Karna dispelled the crowd of Panchala's cars to all directions.

sa: यदा त्वं युधि विक्रान्तौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ। द्रष्टास्येकरथे कर्ण तदा नैवं वदिष्यसि॥
en: When you will see in battle the highly powerful Vasudeva and Dhananjaya stationed in the same car, you will not utter such words, OKarna.

sa: दुर्मुखस्य तु भल्लेन छित्त्वा केतुं महाबलः। जघान चतुरो वाहांश्चतुर्भिनिशितैः शरैः॥
en: Then that mighty hero, cutting off with a broad-headed shaft the standard of Durmukha, slew his four steeds with four arrows of great sharpness.

sa: तस्मान्ते संजय ब्रूहि कर्णभीमौ यथा रणे। अयुध्येतां युधि श्रेष्ठौ परस्परवधैषिणौ॥
en: O Sanjaya, relate to me, how Bhima and Karna, those two foremost of warriors fought with each other, desirous of taking each other's life.

sa: ततः स भगवान् देवो लोकस्रष्टा पितामहः॥ सारथ्ये कल्पितो देवैरीशानस्य महात्मनः।
en: Thereupon that illustrious person-age, that God, the creator of all creatures, the Grandsire was appointed to the charioteership of highsouled Ishana by the celestials.

sa: भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैः पार्थिवैश्च महात्मभिः॥ कौरवान् समरे राजन् प्रतियुध्यस्व भारत।
en: United with your brother and the other high souled rulers of earth do you, O descendant of the Bharatas, give battle to the Kouravas.

sa: तत्राद्भुतं महाराज दृष्टवानस्मि संयुगे। यद् द्रोणो रभसं युद्धे पाञ्चाल्यं नाभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Then O mighty monarch, we beheld a wonderful sight in that battle, in as much Drona striving hard could not approach the Panchala prince.

sa: तान् स सप्तशतान् नागान् सारोहायुधकेतनान्। भूमिष्टो गदया जने वज्रेणेन्द्रि इवाचलान्॥
en: Like Indra, striking down mountains with his thunderbolt Bhima, with his mace, struck down those seven hundred elephants with their riders, weapons and standards.

sa: अथान्यैर्बहुभिर्भल्लैः शिरांस्येषामपातयत्। रोषसंरक्तंनेत्राणि संदष्टौष्ठानि भूतले॥ तानि वक्त्राणि विवभुः कमलानीव भूरिशः।
en: And with ten other shafts cut-off their heads. Those heads with lips and eyes red with rage looked fair like a collection of lotuses.

sa: यतन्तः पुरुषव्याघ्राः सर्वशत्तया महाद्युतिम्। निनीषवो रणे द्रोणं यमस्य सदनं प्रति॥
en: Then those foremost of men fell upon Drona of great effulgence in that battle, desirous of dispatching the latter to the abodes of Death.

sa: सहस्रयामप्रतिमा बभूव प्राणहारिणी। वध्यतां च तथा तेषां क्षतानां च विशेषतः॥
en: And destructive of many lives, appeared to them to consist of a thousand Yamas. While they were being thus slain and mangled by another.

sa: ततः स कदनं चक्रे रिपूणां द्रोणनन्दनः। युगान्ते सर्वभूतानां कालसृष्ट इवान्तकः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereafter the son of Drona began to crush his foes like the Destroyer at the end of the Yuga slaughtering all creatures.

sa: स शल्यसंगृहीताश्वे रथे कर्णः स्थितो बभौ॥ धनुर्विस्फारयन् घोरं परिवेषीव भास्करः।
en: Shalya holding the reins of the horses Karna stood on that car stretching his dreadful bow like the sun enveloped with a circular light.

sa: पार्थ यथा सेना धार्तराष्ट्रीह संयुगे। कर्णेन विहिता वीर गुप्ता वीरैर्महारथैः॥
en: "O heroic son of Pritha, behold grow the army of Dhritarashtra was arranged in battlearray by Karna and encompassed by the most heroic car-warriors.

sa: न विद्यते व्यवस्थानं क्रुद्धयोः कृष्णयोः कचित्। स्रष्टारौ जगतश्चैव सततं पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: When those two Krishnas are roused, they care not for anything and those two foremost of men are creators of real and unreal matters.

sa: कश्मलं प्राविशद् राजा बहु तत्र समादिशन्। स कश्मलसमाविष्टो भीममाहूय पार्थिवः॥
en: Became totally overwhelmed with grief and entreated Bhima with numerous prayers. Then overwhelmed as he was with grief, the king summoned Bhima, near him.

sa: ये गताः पाण्डवं युद्धे रोषामर्षसमन्विताः। तेऽद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते सिन्धवः सागरादिव॥
en: But, O king, those who proceeded to fight against the son of Pandu, being filled even as rivers falling into the sea, never return.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा चरितं तस्य सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनः। त्रिगर्ताः संन्यवर्तन्त संतप्ताः स्वजनं प्रति॥
en: Beholding that conduct of that one of lionlike prowess and tread, the Trigartta warriors greatly afflicted, fell back upon the division of their clansmen.

sa: द्रोणे युधि पराक्रान्ते नर्दमाने मुहुर्मुहुः। पञ्चालेषु च क्षीणेषु वध्यमानेषु पाण्डुषु॥
en: When Drona was displaying his prowess in battle and constantly roaring and when the Pandus, the Panchalas were being slaughtered and reduced in number.

sa: पपात सारथिश्चास्य मुमोह च गदाहतः। स कर्णं सायकानष्टौ व्यसृजत् क्रोधमूर्छितः॥
en: Broke and fell down and his charioteer, also struck with that mace, became insensible. Thereupon furious in rage, Bhima discharged eight shafts at Karna.

sa: द्रवमाणान् रथोदारान् किरन्तं निशितैः शरैः॥ नैनं शक्ष्यामि संसोढुं चरन्तं रणमूर्धनि।
en: Crushing numerous illustrious car-warriors and covering them with his sharp shafts I cannot brook the sight of him careering in thick of the fight.

sa: एतच्छुत्वा तु वचनं शल्यस्यामिततेजसः। हृदि चावश्यकं भावं चक्रे युद्धाय सुस्थित्॥
en: Thus addressed by Shalya of unfathomable prowess Kara reflecting came the conclusion that there is no other alternative but to fight the battle out.

sa: तस्य द्रोणो महाराज स्वर्णपुवाञ्छिलाशितान्। प्रेषयामास संकुद्धः सायकान् दश पञ्च च॥
en: At hin, O mighty monarch, excited with wrath Drona sped ten and five shafts, all whetted on stone and furnished with wings of gold.

sa: दुर्मदस्य च वीरस्य दुष्कर्णस्य च तं रथम्। पादप्रहारेण धरां प्रावेशयदरिंदमः॥
en: That chastiser of foes, buried the car of the heroic Durmada and that of Duskarna into the earth with the stroke of his foot.

sa: पञ्चालानां प्रवरांश्चापि योधान् क्रोधाविष्टः सूतपुत्रस्तरस्वी। बाणैर्विर्याधाहवे सुप्रमुक्तैः शिलाशितै रुकमपुङ्खैः प्रसह्य॥
en: That best of men, Suta's son of great energy, smiling at the two Krishnas, struck the chief men among the Panchalas with aimed arrows.

sa: गतो यथेप्सितं देश हंसो मन इवाशुगः। एवमुच्छिष्टपुष्टः स काको हंसपराजितः॥
en: Putting that ranger of the sky down (on the land) and comforting him the swan repaired quickly to his wished-for region with the mind.

sa: न्यस्तशस्त्रे च भवति हतो भीष्मः पितामहः। शिखण्डिन पुरस्कृस्य फाल्गुनेन महाहवे॥
en: When you had laid aside your arms, Bhishma of mighty prowess was slain in battle by Falguna, who had placed Shikhandin in his front.

sa: भिन्द्यात् सुदुर्भिदं व्यूहं यतमानोऽपि संयुगे। प्रतिज्ञाया गतः पारं हत्वा सैन्धवमर्जुनः॥
en: Arjuna fulfill his vow by killing the king of Sindhu? O hero, how could the son of Pandu, if Drona had not wished it.

sa: दुर्मदस्य ततो भीमः प्रहसन्निव संयुगे। सारथिं च हयांश्चैव शर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: Then Bhima, with a smile, sent the charioteer and the steeds of Durmada in that battle to the abode of Yama with his shafts.

sa: सारथिं पञ्चभिर्बाणै राजन् विव्याध संयुगे। तं निवार्य शरैस्तूर्णं धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः॥
en: Pierced the latter's charioteer, O foremost of the Bharatas, with five arrows. Then the mighty car-warrior Dhistadyumna checking Drona by means of his arrows.

sa: प्रदुद्राव दिशः सर्वा वीक्षमाणं भयादितम्। उत्सृज्य वाहान् समरे चोदयन्तस्तथा परे॥
en: Fled in fear in all directions looking at one another; some left behind their horses, others urged them to the top of their speed.

sa: हृष्टानुदीर्णान् संग्रामे न तथा सूत मामकान्॥ हतांश्चैव विदीर्णाश्च विप्रकीर्णाश्च शंससि। रथिनो विरथांश्चैव कृतान् युद्धेषु मामकान्॥
en: Cheerful and impetuous in battle. But, O Sanjaya, you do not speak so of my warriors. You speak of them as slain, pale and routed and of my car-warriors as (always) made carless in the battle?

sa: इत्युक्त्वा प्राहरत् तूर्णं पाण्डुपुत्राय सूतजः। विव्याध चैनं समरे त्रिसप्तत्या शिलीमुखैः॥
en: Having addressed him thus, the son of Suta struck the son of Pandu most rapidly and pierced him in the battle with seventy-three arrows.

sa: प्रमनन्तं तदा वीरान् भारद्वाजं महारथम्। अभ्यवर्तत संक्रुद्धः शिबी राजा प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then the powerful king Sibi furiously advanced against the heroic son of Bharadvaja, was the mighty-car warrior Drona who engaged in crushing (the enemy).

sa: पञ्चालानां वधं कृत्वा शान्तिं लब्धास्मि कौरव। यदर्थं पुरुषव्याघ्र पुत्रानिच्छन्ति मानवाः॥
en: () ruler of the Kuru, exterminating the Panchalas, I shall regain my peace of mind. O foremost of men, people desire to have children.

sa: तस्य शक्तिममेयात्मा पाण्डवो भुजगोपमाम्। चिक्षेप भरतश्रेष्ठ रथे न्यस्य महद् धनुः॥
en: Then that Pandava, of immeasurable soul, placing his mighty bow on the car, hurled at him (i.e. Kritavarman) a dart (fierce) as a snake.

sa: चापशब्दं ततः कृत्वा तलशब्दं च भैरवम्। अभ्यद्रवत राधेयो भीमसेनरथं प्रति॥
en: Then dreadfully slapping his palms and producing whizzes with his arrows, the sons of Radha began to shower arrows on the car of Bhimasena.

sa: यस्यार्थे शस्त्रमादत्से यमवेक्ष्य च जीवसि। पुत्रस्ते दयितो नित्यं सोऽश्वत्थामा निपातितः॥
en: “He for whom you are wielding your weapons and looking on whom you live, that dearly-loved son of yours by Ashvauhman has been slain.

sa: शौरे रथं वाहयतोऽर्जुनस्य बलं महास्त्राणि च पाण्डवस्य। अहं विजानामि यथावदद्य परोक्षभूतं तव तत् तु शल्य॥
en: Even now I know well the skill of Shouri in the management of cars and the power and great weapons of Arjuna, the son of Pandu. But you have no practical knowledge of them, O Shalya.

sa: मित्रवर्मा त पाञ्चाल्यः क्षत्रधर्मा च भारत॥ द्रोणेन परमेष्वासो गमितो यमसादनम्।
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, the Panchala prince, Mitravarman and Kshatradharman, those mightest bowmen, were sent to the abode of Yama by Drona.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः पुनर्महाराज मद्रराजमरिंदमः। अभ्यभाषत राधेयः संनिवार्योत्तरं वचः। ॥
en: Sanjaya said Once more, O great king, thus silencing the king of Madras, the son of Radha, the chastiser of foes, said to him.

sa: ततः प्रमुदिताः पार्थाः परिवर्युधिष्ठिरम्॥ यथा वृत्रवधे देवाः पुरा शक्र महर्षयः।
en: Then the Parthas filled with delight surrounded Yudhishthira, like the celestials and the sages surrounding Shakra on the occasion of the slaughter of Vritra.

sa: आकृष्यमाणः कौन्तेयो नदत्येव महारवम्। वर्धते चैव तद् घोरं द्रौणेरस्त्रं सुदुर्जयम्॥
en: Thus dragged the puissant son of Kunti (Bhima) began to roar aloud, where-upon the invincible weapon of Drona's son also swelled in its fury.

sa: संसक्तं सात्यकिं ज्ञात्वा बहुभिः कुरुपुङ्गवैः। तत्र गच्छन्तु बहवः प्रवरा रथसत्तमाः॥
en: But yonder comes Savyasachin, O Bharata, towards this division of Drona knowing that Satyaki is here encountered by many foremost warriors of the Kurus.

sa: सोऽविध्यत तदा द्रोणं षष्ट्या साश्वरथध्वजम्। पुनश्चान्यैः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सुप्तं व्याघ्रं तुदनिव॥
en: He then pierced Drona and his steeds. And once more he struck his adversary with sharp arrows, like a man rousing a sleeping tiger.

sa: ततो द्रोणो महाराज नाम विश्राव्य संयुगे। पाण्डुपाञ्चालमत्स्यानां प्रचक्रे कदनं महत्॥
en: Thereafter, O mighty monarch, proclaiming his name in battle, he began to spread havoc among the ranks of the Pandavas, Panchalas and the Matsyas.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वान्तर्हितं भूतं नाम तस्याकरोत् तदा॥ अश्वत्थामेति सोऽौष शूरो नदति पाण्डव।
en: Having heard that sound, an invisible being, master, ascribed to him the Ashvatthman, (horse-voiced). That brave warrior, O son of Pandu, is roaring today.

sa: अनेनास्रेण संग्राते तेजसा च ज्वलिष्यसि। एवमुक्तवा स भगवान् दिवमाचक्रमे प्रभुः॥
en: By means of this weapon and you shall blaze forth in effulgence by its virtue." Having thus spoken that Divine Lord ascended to heaven.

sa: तस्य तत्कुर्वतः कर्म नकुलस्य सुतो रणे। अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद चापं रत्नविभूषितम्॥
en: When he (i.e. Chitrasena) was achieving this feat, the of Nakula, in that engagement, cut-off, with a cresent-shaped arrow, his shaft furnished with gold.

sa: पश्य मूर्धाभिषिक्तानामाचार्य कदनं महत्। कृत्वा प्रमुखतः शूरं भीष्मं मम पितामहम्॥
en: “O Preceptor," (Duryodhana (continued), "Behold this great carnage of those whose heads have undergone the sacred coronation bath, headed by my heroic grandsire Bhisma,

sa: द्रोणं प्रति महाराज विराटश्चैव संयुगे। तं निहत्येषुवर्षं तु द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः॥
en: On Drona, O mighty monarch. Virata also did so in that battle. Then that crusher of foes, viz., Drona, destroying that shower of arrows.

sa: ततः परिवृता योधाः परिवQर्युधिष्ठिरम्॥ वृत्रहत्यै यथा देवाः परिव्रवुः पुरंदरम्। ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा तव पुत्रस्य मारिष।
en: The warriors in Pandavas' army then returned again to battle as they once were fled away. They all took their position around Yudhishthira as all gods had gathered around Indra when the monster Vritra was killed.

sa: अद्य युद्धं महाघोरं तव दास्यामि सात्वत। ततो ज्ञास्यसि तत्त्वेन मद्वीर्यबलपौरुषम्॥
en: Today, O descendant of the Satvata race, I shall fight a terrible fight with you, whence you shall know my great mighty and manliness.

sa: ततो धर्मसुतो जिष्णुं परिष्वज्य विशाम्पते। प्रसृज्य वदनं तस्य पर्याश्वासयत प्रभुः॥
en: Oking! King Yudhishthira, Dharmaputra (son of Dharma) then embraced in tight grip to Arjuna, wiped his face and told the following worlds in consolation.

sa: एष ध्वजाग्रे पार्थस्य प्रेक्षमाणः समन्ततः। दृश्यते वानरो भीमो वीराणां भयवर्धनः॥
en: At the top of the Arjuna's flag a dreadful monkey is seen. It is enhancing fear of Kaurava's warriors with its watch all around.

sa: संजय उवाच एवं सम्भाषमाणानां बहु तत् तज्जनाधिप। पाण्डवानामनीकानि समदृश्यन्त संयुगे॥
en: Sanjaya said When, (monarch, they were thus conversing about many other (subjects) the army of the Pandavas was seen on the field of battle.

sa: कर्णं त्वस्यन्तमस्त्राणि दिव्यानि च बहूनि च॥ कथमिन्द्रोपमं वीरं मृत्युर्युद्धे समस्पृशत्।
en: While Karna was engaged in throwing down his innumerable celestial weapons in battle, how could Death touch that hero who was like Indra himself?

sa: उभौ विश्रुतकर्माणै पौरुषेण बलेन च। उभौ च सदृशौ युद्धे शम्बारामरराजयोः॥
en: Both of them were famous for their courage and strength and they were skilful like the (Asura) and the king of gods in war.

sa: संदिह्यमानो व्यथितः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। अहतं वा हतं वेति पप्रच्छ सुतमात्मनः॥
en: Burning with grief and extremely pained, he then inquired of king Yudhishthira the son of Kunti whether his son was really slain or not.

sa: समभ्यधावद् वृषसेनमाहवे स सूतजस्य प्रमुखे स्थितस्तदा। तमापतन्तं नरवीरमुग्रं महाहवे बाणसहस्रधारिणम्॥ अभ्यापतत् कर्णसुतो महारथं यथा महेन्द्रं नमुचिः पुरा तथा।
en: When Vrishasena, the son of Karna saw Arjuna, the great chariot fighter with a store of several thousand arrows in that great war, he rushed towards him with the same way as Namuci had made an attack on Indra, the king of gods.

sa: दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं सर्वे योधा वा रणदुर्जयाः। ये च केचन राजानः पृथिव्यां यो मागताः। वैकर्तनं हतं दृष्ट्वा कान्यभाषन्त संजय॥
en: And again, O Sanjaya, what did the other warriors, who with difficulty could be vanquished, as well as all the kings of the earth, who had come with the desire of fighting, say, when they beheld the slaughter of the son of Vikartana?

sa: अभ्ययातां महाराज नर्दन्तौ गोवृषाविव॥ भीमसेनरवं श्रुत्वा फाल्गुनस्य च धन्विनः। अप्रीयत महाराज धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ विशोकश्चाभवद् राजा श्रुत्वा तं निनदं तयोः। धनंजयस्य समरे जयमाशास्तवान् विभुः॥
en: Rushed upon your army, monarch, like two bovine bulls. Hearing the shouts of Bhimasena and those of Phalguna the fierce bowman. The very virtuous king Yudhishthira, O monarch, became greatly delighted. Hearing their shouts the king then was relieved of his burden of anxiety. That sovereign then become hopeful of Dhananjaya's success in the battle.

sa: संजय उवाच तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य वेलोवृत्तमिवार्णवम्। गर्जन्त सुमहाकायं दुर्निवारं सुरैरपि।॥ अर्जुनं प्राह दाशार्हः प्रहस्य पुरुर्षभः। अयं सरथ आयाति श्वेताश्वः शल्यसारथिः॥
en: Sanjaya said Vasudeva the foremost of men beholding the great bodied Karna whom the gods could not advancing with roars like the swelling ocean said to Arjuna with a smile. There comes the chariot (of Karna) with gray steeds and Shalya its driver.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो भीमसेनस्तरस्वी शक्तिं चोग्रा प्राहिणोत् ते सुताय। तामापतन्ती सहसातिघोरां दृष्ट्वा सूतस्ते ज्वलितामिवोल्काम्॥ आकर्णपूर्णरिषुभिर्महात्मा चिच्छेद पुत्रो दशभिः पृषत्कैः।
en: The light-handed Bhimasena, being enraged at this, threw a fearful dart at your son, but your noble son drawing his bow to its full length with ten shafts severed that awful dart as it was coming straight to him like a burning brand.

sa: स विक्षिप्यार्जुनस्तूर्णं सैन्धवप्रहिताशरान्॥ युगपत् तस्य चिच्छेद शराभ्यां सैन्धवस्य ह। सारथेश्च शिरः कायाद् ध्वजं च समलंकृतम्॥ स छिन्नयष्टिः सुमहान् धनंजयशराहतः। वराहः सिन्धुराजस्य पपाताग्निशिखोपमः॥ एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु द्रुतं गच्छति भास्करे।
en: Thereupon Arjuna, repuising the sharp shafts shot by the ruler of the Sindhus, cut-off at the same time, with a couple of arrows, the head of Jayadratha's driver and his welldecked standard. Its stay cut-off and itself shattered and struck with arrows, that boars bearing standard of the Sindhu king fell down like a flash of fire. Meanwhile the sun was rapidly going towards the western hills.

sa: योगमभ्यसतस्तस्य नेत्राभ्यां यदसुस्रुवत्। तद्गृहीतं भगवता पाणिना चर्चितं तु तत्॥ निक्षिप्तमात्रं तद्भूमौ ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तृणा। तस्मिन्नश्रुकणे राम वानरः संबभूव ह॥ उत्पन्नमात्रस्तु तदा वानरच नरोत्तम। समाश्वास्य प्रियैर्वाक्यैरुक्तः किल महात्मना॥ पश्य शैलं सुविस्तीर्ण सुरैरध्युषितं सदा। तस्मिन् रम्ये गिरिवरे बहुमूलफलाशनः॥ ममान्तिकचरो नित्यं भव वानरपुंगव। कंचित्कालमिहास्व त्वं ततः श्रेयो भविष्यति॥
en: And from his eyes while going through the Yoga practices tears trickled down. No sooner the Patriarch Brahmä, with his hands, wiped them off into the ground than a monkey originated from those tears. O foremost of men, as soon as that monkey was produced, the high-souled Brahma consoled him in sweet accents and said, "Do you proceed to that leading mountain where the celestials perpetually reside. O foremost of monkeys, living upon many a fruit and root in that picturesque mountain you should always live by me. And while you shall live in this wise for some time you shall be crowned with auspiciousness.”

sa: सौर्येणास्त्रेण तं वीरो लक्ष्मणः पर्यवारयत्। अस्त्रं निवारितं दृष्ट्वा रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।।५७ आददे निशितं बाणमासुरं शत्रुदारणम्। तस्माच्चापाद्विनिष्पेतु स्वराः कूटमुद्गराः॥ शूलानि च भुशुण्ड्यश्च गदाः खङ्गाः परश्वधाः।
en: The heroic Lakşmaņa resisted it with a Solar weapon. Seeing his weapon resisted, Ravana's son, transported with passion, took up an Asura arrow, capable of rending foes. And from that weapon issued daggers and clubs and darts and bhusundis and maces and swords and axes.* *This arrow resembled somewhat the bomb-shells in modern European warfare.

sa: एते वै यान्ति राजानो ब्रूहि त्वमृषिसत्तम। को ह्यत्र याचितो दद्याद्युद्धातिथ्यं ममा ध वै॥ तं ममाख्याहि धर्मज्ञ पिता मे त्वं हि धर्मतः। एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच रावणं पर्वतस्तदा॥ स्वर्गार्थिनो महाराज नैते युद्धार्थिनो नृपाः। वक्ष्यामि ते महाभाग यस्ते युद्धं प्रदास्यति॥ स तु राजा महातेजा: सप्तद्वीपेश्वरो महान्। मांधातेत्यभिविख्यातः स ते युद्धं प्रदास्यति॥ पर्वतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। कृतोऽसौ तिष्ठते राजा तत्समाचक्ष्व सुव्रत॥ सोऽहं यास्यामि तत्रैव यत्रासौ नरपुंगवः। रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मुनि
en: "O foremost of Rsis, do you tell me, who, of these kings going, if prayed for, may offer me the hospitality of a battle? Forsooth you are my father; do you point out (such a man to me) O you conversant with piety." Being thus addressed, Parvata again said to Rāvana, “O great king, all these kings wish for heaven not for battle. I shall point out such a man, O great one, as shall enter into conflict with you. There is a highly powerful king, the lord of seven islands, well known by the name of Măndhāta; he shall enter into an encounter with you.” Hearing the words of Parvata, Rāvana again said, "Do you tell me, O you of great devotion, where this king resides. I shall go where lives this foremost of men.” Hearing the words of Ravana, the sage again said, "The son of Yuvanāśva has conquered

sa: अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवं नारदो भगवानृषिः। क्व खल्विदानी मार्गेण त्वयेहान्येन गम्यते॥ अयं खलु सुदुर्गम्यः प्रेतराजपुरं प्रति। मार्गो गच्छति दुर्धर्ष यमस्यामित्रकर्शन ॥
en: Then the reverend sage Närada spoke to the Ten-necked Ravana, Who save you can on forsooth go that journey? Verily, o irrepressible one, O destroyer of foes, the way leading to the city of the lord of the dead is difficult of access.

sa: नदन् नादेन महता मेघस्वनमहास्वनः। प्रवराराक्षसान् हत्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः॥ आकुलां नगरी कृत्वा व्यथयित्वा च रावणम्। अर्दयित्वा महावीरान् वैदेहीमभिवाद्य च॥ आजगाम महातेजाः पुनर्मध्येन सागरम्।
en: And sending up mighty sounds, that exceedingly energetic one gifted with a powerful voice like that of the clouds, having slain the foremost Rākşasas and rendered his name famous, having filled the city with lamentations and afflicted Rāvana, having distressed the mighty heroes and paid obeisance to Vaidehī, again held his course along the mid-ocean.

sa: यदि वैश्रवणस्य त्वं यमस्य वरुणस्य च। चारुरूपमिदं कृत्वा प्रविष्टो नः पुरीमिमाम्॥ विष्णुना प्रेषितो वापि दूतो विजयकाक्षिणा। नहि ते वानरं तेजो रूपमात्रं तु वानरम्॥
en: If you belong to Vaisravana, or to Yama, or to Varuņa, and had entered into this city of ours disguising (your proper shape), or if you had been despatched by Vişnu burning for victory, (tell us this truly). Your prowess is certainly not hat of a monkey, your form alone is that of a monkey.

sa: राक्षसांस्त्रासयामास कार्तवीर्यार्जुनस्तदा। रावणं गृह्य नगरं प्रविवेश सुहद्धृतः॥ र्द्विजैः सपौरैः पुरुहूतसंनिभः। ततोऽर्जुनः स्वां प्रविवेश तां पुरी बलिं निगृह्येव सहस्रलोचनः॥
en: Having thus struck terror to the night-rangers, he, encircled by his own kinsmen, repaired to his own city with Ravana, carrying him bound like to Indra carrying Bali bound. Thereupon flowers and fried paddy were showered upon him by the Brāhmaṇas and citizens.

sa: यदा ह्यकामां कामा” धर्षयिष्यति योषितम्॥ मूर्धा तु सप्तधा तस्य शकलीभविता तदा। तस्मिन्नदाहृते शापे ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे॥ देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता।
en: Whenever he shall, stricken by lust, ravish a reluctant damsel, his head shall be sundered into seven pieces. As soon as this curse, like to a burning flame, was uttered, the celestials bugles were sounded and a shower of flowers fell from heavens.

sa: कथं वाग्निं जुहुयां पूजये वा कस्मिन् काले केनधर्मो न नश्येत्। एतत् सर्वं सुभगे प्रब्रवीहि यथा लोकान् विरजाः संचरेयम्॥
en: When and how must one offer oblations to the fire and when must he worship, so that his virtue may not be destroyed? O blessed lady, tell me all, so that I may live in this world without any passion, craving or desire.

sa: इदं त्विदानी गत एव निश्चितं तेषामर्थे पाण्डवानां यदास्थ! तेनाद्य मन्ये नासि हितो ममेति कथं हि पुत्रं पाण्डवार्थे त्यजेयम्॥
en: How have you settled all this in your mind. When you have spoken all this on behalf of the Pandavas. I perceive you are not at all friendly to me. How can I leave my son for the sake of sons of Pandu?

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा मन्त्रिणः सर्वे त्यज्य चण्डालरूपिणम्॥ प्राद्रवन् सहिता राम पौरा येऽस्यानुगामिनः। एको हि राजा काकुत्स्थ जगाम परमात्मवान् ॥
en: And, O Rāma, beholding him in the guise of a Chandala, his counsellors as well as followers, renouncing him, fled in a body. And, O Kākutstha, maintaining himself in patience, the monarch burning day and night, all alone went to the ascetic Viśvāmitra.

sa: स सम्पातिस्तदा राजञ्छ्रुत्वा सुमहदप्रियम्॥ विषण्णचेताः पप्रच्छ पुनरस्मानरिंदम। कः स रामः कथं सीता जटायुश्च कथं हतः॥ इच्छामि सर्वमेवैतच्छ्रोतुं प्लवगसत्तमाः।
en: Hearing this very disagreeable news, O king, Sampati, became dejected at heart and O tormentor of foes again asked “who is this Rama? Why was Sita abducted? And how was Jatayu slain? O best of monkeys, I am desirous of hearing all this."

sa: यदा ह्येनं परिवृतं कन्याभिर्देवरूपिणम्। प्रभिन्नमिव मातङ्गं परिकीर्णं करेणुभिः॥ मत्स्यमर्थपतिं पार्थं विराटं समुपस्थितम्। पश्यामि तूर्यमध्यस्थं दिशो नश्यन्ति मे तदा॥
en: When I look upon that good-like Partha surrounded by females in this music hall like an elephant of rent temples encircled by sheelephant before Virata, the king of the Matsyas, then all the cardinal points seem to me to have lost their existence.

sa: सत्त्वोपपन्नः पुरुषोऽमरोपमः श्यामो युवा वारणयूथपोपमः। आमुच्य कम्बूपरि हाटके शुभे विमुच्य वेणीमपिना कुण्डले॥ स्रग्वी सुकेशः परिधाय चान्यथा शुशोभ धन्वी कवची शरीयथा। आरुह्य यानं परिधावतां भवान् सुतैः समो मे भव वा मया समः॥
en: Endowed with might you appear like a celestials; you are are young and of dark complexion and resemble the leader of a herd of elephants. Although you have worn fine conch-bracelets beset with gold ear-rings and loosened your braid, yet you shine as one decked with garlands and fine hairs and equipped with bow, bow, mail and arrows; ascending the car you wander at your pleasure. Be you like my son or like myself.

sa: ददाति यत् पार्थिवं यत् करोति यद् वा तपस्तप्यति यज्जुहोति। न तस्य नाशोऽस्ति न चापकर्षो नान्यस्तदश्नाति स एव कर्ता॥
en: O ruler of the earth, that which one gives, or dose, or the asceticism one practices or the sacrifices one makes can never be destroyed nor do they suffer deterioration in quality and the fruits are enjoyed by no body save the doer.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो राज्ञः सुतो ज्येष्ठः प्राविशत् पृथिवीट्टायः। सोऽभिवाद्य पितुः पादौ ककं चाप्युपतिष्ठत॥ ततो रुधिरसंयुक्तमनेकाग्रमनागसम्। भूमावासीनमेकान्ते सैरभ्या प्रत्युपस्थितम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then the eldest son of the king, Bhuminjaya, entered there. Having saluted the feet of his father, he approached Kanka. He saw him there, bathed in blood, sitting on the ground, at one end of the court, attended upon by Sairandhri.

sa: सूर्य उवाच यदि तात ददास्येते वलिाणे कुण्डले शुभे। त्वमप्येनमथो ब्रूया विजयार्थं महाबलम्॥ नियमेन प्रदद्यां ते कुण्डले वै शतक्रतो।
en: Surya said: O highly-powerful son, if you bestow your beautiful car-rings to the wielder of the sorrow thunderbolt, you should, in order to secure victory, say to him, “O lord of hundred sacrifices, I can only part with my ear-rings under a condition."

sa: यक्ष उवाच इमे ते भ्रातरो राजन् वार्यमाणा मयासकृत्॥ बलात् तोयं जिहीर्षन्तस्ततो वै मृदिता मया। न पेयमुदकं राजन् प्राणानिह परीप्सता॥ पार्थ मा साहसं कार्मिम पूर्वपरिग्रहः। प्रश्नानुक्त्वा तु कौन्तेय ततः पिब हरस्व च।॥
en: The Yaksha said: These brothers of you, O king, though again and again forbidden by me. Wanted to take away water by force. I have therefore killed them. He that has a love for his life ought not, O king, to drink this water. O Partha, do not attempt it. This (pond) has been taken possession of by me before. O son of Kunti, answering my questions, you may drink and take away water.

sa: राजा च क्षत्ता च महानुभावौ भीष्मे स्थिते परवन्तौ भवेताम्। अयं तु धर्मज्ञतया महात्मा न कामयेद् यो नृवरो नदीजः॥
en: The king himself and Vidura of great soul, are so long as Bhishma is alive, but his subordinates; in fact owing to his being conversant with virtue, the one born of the river (Ganga), that foremost of kings does not desire the kingship.

sa: अनलायाः शुकी पुत्री कङ्कस्तु सुरसासुतः। अरुणस्य भार्या श्येनी तु वीर्यवन्तौ महाबलौ॥ संपातिं जनयामास वीर्यवन्तं जटायुषम्। सुरसाजनयन्नागान्कएँः पुत्रांस्तु पन्नगान्॥
en: Anala had another daughter named Shuki. Surasa gave birth to a son, named Kanka. Aruna's wife Shyeni gave birth to two very energetic and powerful sons, named Sampati and the mighty Jatayu. Surasa also gave birth to the Nagas and Kadru the Pannagas.

sa: ददौ संपूज्य तद्दिव्यं गाण्डीवं धनुरुत्तमम्। यत्र भ्रातृन्निपतितान् द्रौपदी च युधिष्ठिरः॥ दृष्ट्वा हित्वा जगामैव सर्वाननवलोकयन्। एतत्सप्तदशं पर्व महाप्रस्थानिकं स्मृतम्॥
en: After worshipping him duly, returned to him the great celestial bow Gandiva. Yudhishthira went on his journey and did not look back when one afier the other of his brothers, including Draupadi dropped down dead. Thus is told the seventeenth Parva, called, Mahaprasthanika.

sa: जस्ता विगतसंकल्पा दृष्ट्वा पार्थान् महौजसः। मुक्तान् हव्यभुजश्चैव संयुक्तान् द्रुपदेन च॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं तु संचिन्त्य तथैव च शिखण्डिनम्। दुपदस्यात्मजांश्चान्यान् सर्वयुद्धविशारदान्॥
en: Seeing the greatly powerful sons of Pritha escaped from the house of lac and allied with Drupada and thinking of Dhrishtaduymna, Shikhandin and also other sons of Drupada who were all learned in every art of war, he (Duryodhana) became depressed and alarmed.

sa: मा पिता रुद मा मातर्मा स्वसस्त्विति चाब्रवीत्। प्रहसन्निव सर्वांस्तानेकैकमनुसर्पति॥ ततः स तृणमादाय प्रहृष्टः पुनरब्रवीत्। अनेनाहं हनिष्यामि राक्षसं पुरुषादकम्॥
en: He said O father, o you mother, O sister also, do not weep.” Thus saying and smiling, he came to each of them. Then taking up a blade of glass, he said again in joy, “I shall kill the cannibal Rakshasas by it.

sa: अधर्मेण न नो धर्मः संयुज्यति कथंचन। लोकश्चायं वरारोहे धर्मोऽयमिति मन्यते॥ धार्मिकश्च कुरूणां स भविष्यति न संशयः। धर्मेण चापि दत्तस्य नाधर्मे रंस्यते मनः॥ तस्माद् धर्मं पुरस्कृत्य नियता त्वं शुचिस्मिते। उपचाराभिचाराभ्यां धर्ममावाहयस्व वै॥
en: O beautiful lady, Dharma will ever be able to pollute us with sin and people will also consider that what we do is never sinful. There is no doubt the son thus begotten will be virtuous among the Kurus. Begotten by Dharma, his mind will never be in sin. Therefore, O lady of sweets smiles,, keeping virtue before your eyes and observing all vows, call Dharma by the help of your solicitations and incantations.

sa: नाम चास्यैतदेवेह भविष्यति शुभानने। इत्युक्त्वा स निरक्रामद् भगवानृषिसत्तमः॥ ततो निष्क्रान्तमालोक्य सत्या पुत्रमथाब्रवीत्। शशंस स पुनर्मात्रे तस्य बालस्य पाण्डुताम्॥
en: O beautiful featured lady, the name of your son will be accordingly Pandu, (pale.)" Having said this, the excellent and illustrious Rishi came out and met her mother who asked him about the child. He told her that the child will be pale.

sa: न दोषो भविता चैव सत्येनैतद् ब्रवीम्यहम्। स्वतन्त्रां मां विजानीहि योऽधर्मः सोऽस्तु वै मयि। त्वय्यावेशितचित्ता च स्वतन्त्रास्मि भजस्व माम्॥
en: You will incur no sin. I tell you truly. Know that I am my own mistress. It there be any sin in this, let it visit me only. My heart is devoted to you. I am my own mistress. Do you accept me.

sa: तथैव च मनुष्येषु ये मनुष्याः प्रधानतः। आस्तिकाः श्रद्दधानाश्च बहुभिर्जन्मभिः स्तवैः॥ भक्त्या ह्यनन्यमीशानं परं देवं सनातनम्। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा भावेनामिततेजसः॥ शयाना जाग्रमाणाश्च व्रजन्नुपविशंस्तथा। उन्मिषन् निमिषंश्चैव चिन्तयन्तः पुनः पुनः॥ शृण्वन्तः श्रावयन्तश्च कथयन्तश्च ते भवम्। स्तुवन्तः स्तूयमानाश्च तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च॥
en: Those foremost of men who are endued with faith and devotion, hear and recite for others and utter with respect the praises of that highest and eternal Lord, viz., Ishana. in all their successive lives and worship him in thought, word and deed, and worshipping him thus at all times, viz., when they are lying or seated or walking or awake or opening the eyelids or shutting them, and thinking of him again and again, become objects of respect with all their fellow men and derive great pleasure and exceeding joy.

sa: न हि देवा न गन्धर्वा नासुरा न च पन्नगाः। प्रभवन्तीह भूतानां प्राप्तानामुत्तमां गतिम्॥ एतदेवंविधं दृष्टमाश्चर्यं तत्र मे द्विज।
en: Neither gods, nor Gandharvas, nor Asuras, nor Nagas, can be considered as superior to those creatures who attain to this excellent end of coming into the solar disc. Even such, 0 twice-born one, was the wonderful incident that I saw on that occasion.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं हृतायां कृष्णायां प्राप्य क्लेशमनुत्तमम्। विहाय काम्यकं राजा सह भ्रातृभिरच्युतः॥ पुनद्वैतवनं रम्यमाजगाम युधिष्ठिरः। स्वादुमूलफलं रम्यं विचित्रबहुपादपम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having felt great distress for the abduction of Krishna, the undeteriorating king Yudhishthira together with his brothers leaving Kamayaka returned to the charming and delightful Dvaiytvana, full of fruits and roots of delicious taste and abounding in various picturesque trees.

sa: नारायणं हृषीकेशमश्विनौ यमजौ तथा। यः स वैरार्थमुद्भूतः संघर्षजननस्तथा। तं कर्णं विद्धि कल्याणि भास्करं शुभदर्शने॥ यश्च पाण्डवदायादो हतः षड्भिर्महारथैः। स सोम इह सोभद्रो योगादेवाभवद् द्विधा॥ द्विधा कृत्वाऽऽत्मनो देहमादित्यं तपतां वरम्। लोकांश्च तापयानं वै विद्धि कर्णं च शोभने॥
en: Hrishikesha is Narayana, and the wins are the Ashvins. That foremost of heat-giving ones, viz., Surya, having divided his body in two parts continued with one portion to give heat to the worlds and with another to live as Karna. He who was born as the son of Arjuna, that gladdener of all, that heir of the properties of the Pandavas, who was killed by six carwarriors (fighting together) was Soma. He was of born Subhadra. Through Yoga power he had divided himself in two parts.

sa: ऋक्षाश्च वानराश्चैव सप्तारण्याः स्मृता नृप। गौरजाविमनुष्याश्च अश्वाश्वतरगर्दभाः॥ एते ग्राम्या: समाख्याताः पशवः सप्त साधुभिः। एते वै पशवो राजन् ग्राम्यारण्याश्चतुर्दश॥
en: ) Cows, goats, sheep, men, horses, mules and donkey i.e. seven animals are considered to be domestic by the learned men. O king! Thus, the grand total of village dweller and forest dwellers (Vanavasi) is fourteen in number i.e. these are fourteen animals.

sa: नाधर्मस्ते भविता प्राणिनां वै त्वं वै धर्मस्त्वं हि धर्मस्य चेशा। धा भूत्वा धर्मनित्या धरित्री तस्मात् प्राणान् सर्वथेमान् नियच्छ॥
en: Verily sin shall not be yours. You shall be the righteousness of living creatures, and the presiding deity of that righteousness. Devoted to virtue and observant of your duties, you shall control all creatures. Therefore destroy always the lives of these corporeal creatures.

sa: वर्षाणि तेषु कौरव्य सप्तोक्तानि मनीषिभिः॥ महामेरुर्महाकाशो जलदः कुमुदोत्तरः। जलधारो महाराज सुकुमार इति स्मृतः॥ रेवतस्य त कौमारः श्यामस्य मणिकाञ्चनः।
en: O descendant of Kuru it is said by the learned that there are seven Varshas in that island. The Varsha of Meru is called Mahakasha, that of the water-giver (Malaya) is called Kumudottara. That of Jaladhara is called that of Shyama, called Manikanchana.

sa: तथैव चापनिर्घोषं चक्रतुस्तौ महारथौ। तयोः शङ्खनिनादेन रथनेमिस्वनेन च॥ दारिता सहसा भूमिश्चकम्पे च ननाद च। नोभयोरन्तरं कश्चिद् ददृशे भरतर्षभ।५८।।
en: With the sound of their conchs and the rattle of their car-wheels, the very earth appeared to be rent asunder. She began to tremble. Subterranean noise was heard. O foremost of the Bharata race, none could detect any defect in any of them.

sa: रमते यत्र वैदेही त्वमहं चैव लक्ष्मणः। तादृशो दृश्यतां देशः संनिकृष्टजलाशयः॥ वनरामण्यकं यत्र जलरामण्यकं तथा। संनिकृष्टं च यस्मिस्तु समित्पुष्पकृशोदकम्॥
en: Do you find out such a place in the vicinity of a tank where yourself Sītā and I may dwell happily, which is graced with the garniture of woods and delightful with liquid lapses, and whose neighbourhood yields fuel, flowers, Kuća and water.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः॥ त्रिशङ्कुरिति विख्यात इक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धनः। तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना यजेयमिति राघव॥ गच्छेयं स्वशरीरेण देवतानां परां गतिम्।
en: O Rāghava, it came to pass that at this time, that enhance of Ikşvāku's line, the celebrated and truthful Trisanku of subdued senses made up his mind, saying, 'I will perform a sacrifice, and in body win the prime way of the celestials.'

sa: इदं मेध्यमिदं स्वादु निष्टप्तमिदमग्निना। एवमास्ते स धर्मात्मा सीतया सह राघवः॥ तथा तत्रासतस्तस्य भरतस्योपयायिनः। सैन्यरेणुश्च शब्दश्च प्रादुरास्तां नभस्पृशौ ॥
en: This clean meat tastes sweet, having been roasted in fire. The righteous Rāghava was thus seated in company with Sītā, when Bharata's followers came there. And filling the heavens, there arose clouds of dust raised by the army as well as an uproar.

sa: ककुभः ककुभोरूं तां व्यक्तं जानाति मैथिलीम्। लतापल्लवपुष्पाढ्यो भाति ह्येष वनस्पतिः॥ भ्रमरैरूपगीतश्च यथा द्रुमवरो ह्यसि। एष व्यक्तं विजानाति तिलकस्तिलकप्रियाम्॥
en: This Kakubha know for certain about Maithilī having thighs like to Kakubha. You stands beautifully that Vanaspati being enveloped with creepers flowers and leaves and filled with the hum of Bhramaras. Surely dose this Tilaka know about her who was fond of her.

sa: तथा शप्त्वा च वै शक्रं भार्यामपि च शप्तवान्। इह वर्षसहस्राणि बहूनि निवसिष्यसि॥ वातभक्षा निराहारा तप्यन्ती भस्मशायिनी। अदृश्या सर्वभूतानामाश्रमेऽस्मिन् वसिष्यसि ॥ यदा त्वेतद् वनं घोरं रामो दशरथात्मजः। आगमिष्यति दुर्धर्षस्तदा पूता भविष्यसि॥ तस्यातिथ्येन दुर्वृत्ते लोभमोहविवर्जिता। मत्सकाशं मुदा युक्ता स्वं वपुर्धारयिष्यसि॥
en: And having seen Sakra in this plight, he cursed his wife also, 'These weary thousand years you shall pass, feeding upon air, without food, engaged in asceticism in the dust, and you shall remain in this hermitage unseen of any. And when the irrepressible son of Dasaratha, Rāma, shall come to this deep wood, you shall be cleansed of your sin. And, O wicked one, ministering to him the rites of hospitality with a mind free from ignorance and covetousness, you shall in your own form with joy regain my side.'

sa: प्रहृष्टरूपाविव रामलक्ष्मणौ विराधमुर्त्यां प्रदरे निपात्य तम्। ननन्दतुर्वीतभयौ महावने शिलाभिरन्तर्दधतुश्च राक्षसम्॥ ततस्तु तौ काञ्चनचित्रकार्मुको निहत्य रक्षः परिगृह्य मैथिलीम्। विजह्रतुस्तौ मुदितौ महावने दिवि स्थितौ चन्द्रदिवाकराविव॥
en: Having thrown him into the hole in the earth, Rāma and Lakşmaņa, their fear being removed, and covered the Rākṣasa with rocks. And having slain the Rākşasa and taken Mithila's daughter, those ones having bows decked in gold, being delighted, rejoiced in that mighty forest, like the sun and the moon seated in the sky.

sa: ते नष्टसंज्ञास्तृषिताः सम्भ्रान्ताः सलिलार्थिनः॥ परिपेतुर्बिले तस्मिन् कंचित् कालमतन्द्रिताः। ते कृशा दीनवदनाः परिश्रान्ताः प्लवङ्गमाः॥ आलोकं ददृशुर्वीरा निराशा जीविते यदा।
en: And deprived of their sense, and tried with thirst, and bewildered, and thirsting for water, they for a time vigilantly descended in darkness down the cave. And emaciated, with woebegone faces, and spent, those monkeys despairing of their lives, (at last) saw light.

sa: ततः सीतां समानीय सर्वाभरणभूषिताम्। समक्षमग्नेः संस्थाप्य राघवाभिमुखे तदा॥ अब्रवीज्जनको राजा कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनम्। इयं सीता मम सुता सहधर्मचरी तव॥ प्रतीच्छ चैनां भद्रं ते पाणं गृह्णीष्व पाणिना। पतिव्रता महाभागा छायेवानुगता सदा॥
en: Then bringing Sītā adorned with various ornaments near the fire, and placing her before Rāghava, king Janaka addressed the enchancer of Kausalyā's joy, saying, This Sītā, my daughter, to you accept, good betide you, as your partner in the observance of every duty: do you take her hand by yours. May she be of excited piety, and devoted to her husband; ever following you like your shadow!

sa: इमे च पुरुषव्याघ्र ये तिष्ठन्त्यभितो दिशम्। शतं शतं कुण्डलिनो युवानः खङ्गपाणयः॥ विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः परिघायतबाहवः।। शोणांशुवसनाः सर्वे व्याघ्रा इव दुरासदाः॥
en: And, you foremost of men, these youths envisioning (the celestial) by hundreds, wearing earrings, and bearing swords in their hands, are broad of chest, have arms resembling bludgeons in size, and are clad in crimson vesture, like to tigers incapable of being approached.

sa: न तदां त्वां पिता ज्येष्ठः पितृत्वेनाभिवीक्षते। किं ते तद् विस्मृतं पार्थ यदेष कुलपांसनः॥ दुर्बुद्धिर्विदुरं प्राह द्यूते किं जितमित्युत। तमेवं वादिनं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। उवाच वचनं धीमान् जोषमास्वेति भर्त्सयन्॥
en: Your eldest father did not then look at you with eyes of parental affection. Have you forgotten, O Partha, that it was this wretch of our family, of wicked understanding, who enquired of Vidura, when the match at dice was going on, 'What has been won?' Hearing thus far, king Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, gifted with great intelligence, rebuked him and told him to be silent.

sa: तेषामन्योन्यभक्षाणां सर्वेषां देहचारिणाम्। अग्निर्वैश्वानरो मध्ये सप्तधा दीव्यतेऽन्तरा॥ घ्राणं जिहा च चक्षुश्चत्वक् च श्रोत्रं च पञ्चमम्। मनो बुद्धिश्च सप्तैता जिह्वा वैश्वानरार्चिषः॥ प्रेयं दृश्यं च पेयं च स्पृश्यं श्रव्यं तथैव च। मन्तव्यमथ वोद्धव्यं ताः सप्त समिधो मम॥ घ्राता भक्षयिता द्रष्टा स्प्रष्टा श्रोता च पञ्चमः। मन्ता बोद्धा च सप्तैते भवन्ति परमविजः॥ प्रेये पेये च दृश्ये च स्पृश्ये श्रव्ये तथैव च। मन्तव्येऽप्यथ बोद्धव्ये सुभगे पश्य सर्वदा॥
en: Hence, utterers of Brahma practise penances which have myself for their goal. In the midst of all those vital airs which swallow up one another and move within the body, shines forth the fire called Vaishvanara made up of seven flames. The nose, the tongue, the eye, the skin, the car which numbers the fifth, the mind, and the understanding, these are the seven tongues of that Vaishvanara's flame. That which is smelt that which is seen, that which is drunk, that which is touched, as also that which is heard, that which is thought of, and that which is understood, these are the seven sorts of fuel for me. That which smells, that which eats, that which sces, that which touches, that which sees, that which touches, that which hears, numbering the fifth; that which thinks, and that which unders

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तवति वाक्यं तु कृष्णे देवकिनन्दने। भीष्मं शान्तनवं भूयः पर्यपृच्छद् युधिष्ठिरः॥ निर्णये वा महाबुद्धे सर्वधर्मविदां वर। प्रत्यक्षमागमो वेति किं तयोः कारणं भवेत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said After Krishna, the son of Devaki, had said these words, Yudhishthira once more asked Bhishma the son of Shantanu, saying, O you of great intelligence, O foremost of all persons, knowing duties, which, indeed of the two, direct perception and the scriptures, is to be considered as authority for coming to a conclusion?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रवेशनं तस्यां चक्रे राजा युधिष्ठिरः। अयुतं भोजयित्वा तु ब्राह्मणानां नराधिपः॥ साज्येन पयसेनैव मधुना मिश्रितेन च। कृसरेणाथ जीवन्त्या हविष्येण च सर्वशः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having fed thousands of Brahmanas with sweetened milk mixed with rice, honey and Ghee, with fruits and roots and with the meat of boar and deer the ruler of men king Yudhishthira entered into it (the palace). With food seasoned with sesame, with Tabanti (a sort of vegetable), with rice mixed with Ghee.

sa: काशिराजश्च शैब्यश्च शिखण्डी च महारथः। धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः॥ पाञ्चाल्याश्च महेष्वासा द्रौपद्याः पञ्च चात्मजाः। सर्वे दध्मुर्महाशङ्खान् सिंहनादांश्च नेदिरे॥
en: The king of Kashi, and Shaivya and Shikhandin, the great car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna and Virata and the great carwarrior Satyaki and the great bowman the Panchala king, and also the five sons of Draupadi, all blew their large conches and sent forth lion-like roars.

sa: तथा ब्रुवाणामपि धर्मवत्सलां न च स्म सीतां नृवरो निनीषति। उवाच चैनां बहु संनिवर्तने वने निवासस्य च दु:खितां प्रति॥
en: That best of men, reluctant to take Sītā with him, who had spoken thus and who was greatly attached to virtue, related to her about the many miseries consequent upon dwelling in the forest, with a view to prevent her from following him.

sa: तया प्रयुक्तया सम्यग् जगत् सर्वं प्रकाशते। तेन त्वं ब्रह्मणा तात संयुक्तः सुसमाहितः॥ देवतानां यथाकालं प्रसादं प्रतिपालय। तपसा योजयात्मानमुग्रेण भरतर्षभ॥ धनुष्मान् कवची खड्गी मुनिः साधुव्रते स्थितः। न कस्यचिद् ददन्मार्गं गच्छ तातोत्तरां दिशम्॥
en: O child, if used by you, the whole universe will be brought to your view by that knowledge, Having attentively received that Brahma-knowledge. Attain in due time the grace of the celestials. O best of the Bharata race, devotes yourself to auster asceticism. Armed with the bow and the sword and clad in armour, devote yourself to austere asceticism and deep meditation. O child, without giving way to any body, go towards the north.

sa: व्याध उवाच दैवतप्रतिमो हि त्वं यस्त्वं धर्ममनुव्रतः। पुराणं शाश्वतं दिव्यं दुष्प्राप्यमकृतात्मभिः॥ मातापित्रोः सकाशं हि गत्वा त्वं द्विजसत्तम। अतन्द्रितः कुरु क्षिप्रं मातापित्रोर्हि पूजनम्। अतः परमहं धर्मं नान्यं पश्यामि कंचन॥
en: The Fowler said: O foremost of Brahmanas, as you assiduously practise these divine, ancient and eternal virtues which are so difficult to be acquired even by pure-minded men, you seem to be a divine being. Return soon to the side of your parents and be quick and diligent in honouring your father and mother, for I do not know, if there is any virtue higher than this.

sa: तं वानरवरंधीमानतिकायं महाबलम्। स्वर्गपन्थानमावृत्य हिमवन्तमिव स्थितम्॥ दृष्ट्वा चैनं महाबाहुरेकं तस्मिन् महावने। अथोपसृज्य तरसा विभीर्भीमस्ततो बली॥ सिंहनादं चकारोग्रं वज्राशनिसमं बली। तेन शब्देन भीमस्य वित्रेसुमंगपक्षिणः॥
en: The intelligent Bhima saw that mighty and huge monkey-chief lying like a second Himalayas obstructing the path of heaven. Seeing him alone in that great forest the undaunted, the mighty-armed and the greatly strong Bhima, quickly came to him and uttered a loud lion-like roar. At his that loud roar, beasts and birds were terrified.

sa: विभाण्डकस्याव्रजत: स राजा पशून् प्रभूतान् पशुपांश्च वीरान्। विभाण्डकः परिपृच्छेद् यदा वः॥ स वक्तव्यः प्राञ्जलिभिर्भवद्भिः पुत्रस्य ते पशवः कर्षणं च। किं ते प्रियं वै क्रियतां महर्षे दासाः स्म सर्वे तव वाचि बद्धाः॥
en: All along the way by which Vibhandaka would come (He placed) many beasts and many heroic keepers of those beasts, (ordering them thus) “When the Great Rishi Vibhandaka will enquire after his son, you must reply to him with joined hands, saying "All these cattle and all these tilled fields belong to your son. O great Rishi, what pleasing work of yours should we do? We are your servants we are as your commands."

sa: उपास्व कौन्तेय सहानुजस्त्वं तस्याश्रमं पुण्यतमं प्रविश्य। योऽसौ बन्दिं जनकस्याथ यज्ञे॥ वादी विप्रायो बाल एवाभिगम्य वादे भक्त्वा मज्जयामास नद्याम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, worship with your younger brothers the sacred hermitage of him who had for his grandson Ashtavakra, who when he was but a child had caused Bandi to be drowned in a river after having defeated him in a controversy).

sa: पृच्छेत्यब्रवीदृषिः। सोऽब्रवीदायुष्मन्तः सर्वगुणप्रमुदिताः। अथायुष्मन्तं स्वर्गस्थानं चतुर्भिर्यातव्यं स्यात् कोऽवतरेत्। अयमष्टकोऽवतरेदित्यब्रवीदृषिः॥ किं कारणमित्यपृच्छत्। अथाचष्टाष्टकस्य गृहे मया उषितं स मां रथेनानुप्रावहदथापश्यमनेकानि गोसहस्राणि वर्णशो विविक्तानि तमहमपृच्छं कस्येमा गाव इति सोऽब्रवीत्। मया निसृष्टा इत्येतास्तेनैव स्वयं श्लाघति कथितेन। एषोऽवतरेदथ त्रिभिर्यातव्यं साम्प्रतं कोऽवतरेत्॥
en: He asked, "For what cause?” The Rishi said, "I lived for a few days in the palace of Ashtaka. He one day took me out of the city on his car. I saw there thousands of cows each distinguished by various colour. I asked him whose kine are these. He said, “I myself have made gifts of them.” By these words he flourished his own praise; for this reason he will fall (first). (He said), "we shall then remain, there who among us will fall first?”

sa: कर्ण उवाच त्रयः किलेमे ह्यधना भवन्ति। दासः पुतश्चास्वतन्त्रा च नारी। दासस्य पत्नी त्वधनस्य भद्रे हीनेश्वरा दासधनं च सर्वम्॥
en: Karna said Of all the persons in this assembly, Bhisma, Khattwa (Vidura) and the preceptor of the Kurus (Droria) appear to be independent (men), for they always speak of their master as wicked, they always censure him and never wish for his prosperity.

sa: आहृत्य च यशो दीप्तं सुयुद्धेनात्मनो भुवि। विसृज्य शरवर्षाणि प्रताप्त च दिशो दश॥ सुपः समरे कर्णः स शान्तः पार्थतेजसा।
en: Having made a downpour of arrows and burnt the ten cardinal points that best of men with his sons was destroyed by Partha. He left the world but took away with him his fame which he had won on earth by fair fight.

sa: अनर्हानपि चैवान्यान्मन्यते श्रीमतो जनान्। एतस्मात् कारणादेतद् दुःखं भूयोऽनुवर्तते॥ ईर्ष्याभिमानसम्पत्रा राजन् पुरुषमानिनः। कच्चित् त्वं न तथा राजन् मत्सरी कोसलाधिप।॥
en: Such a person consider others however undeserving, as men blessed with prosperity. Therefore, those who are possessed of malice and vanity and puffed up with a sense of egoism, suffer more misery still. You however, O king, are not sullied by such vices.

sa: इति राजन् यमः प्राह वर्तते च तथैव तत्। अथ भूयांसमेवार्थं करिष्यामि पुनः पुनः॥
en: Friends like ourselves can give to friends like you the help of their intelligence in times of danger. This crow of mine, O king, has been killed for doing your business.

sa: निहतं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा पीडितं चापि पाण्डवैः। ध्रुवमेष्यति संग्रामे वधायैवात्मनो नृपः॥ एवमुक्तः फल्गुनस्तु कृष्णं वचनमब्रवीत। धृतराष्ट्रसुताः सर्वे हता भीमेन माधव॥ यावेतावास्थितौ कृष्ण तावद्य न भविष्यतः।
en: Seeing his own soldiers assailed and killed by the Pandavas, the Kuru king will certainly come to battle for his own destruction.”—Thus addressed by Krishna, Phalguna said to him:"almost all the sons of Dhritarashtra, O giver of honours, have been killed by. Bhirna. Only these two still survive; they however, O Krishna, shall also be killed today.

sa: एतेषां पितरश्चैव तथैव च पितामहाः। मदर्थं निहता युद्धे रामेणाक्लिश्कर्मणा॥ तेषामपचितिश्चैव मया कार्या महामुने।
en: Their fathers and grandfathers have been killed for my sake by the highly powerful Rama. It is my duty, O great sage, to see that their funeral rites are properly performed.

sa: न शङ्खलिखितां वृत्तिं शक्यमास्थाय जीवितुम्। विशेषतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ प्रजापालनमीप्सया॥
en: A Kshatriya should not live, depending upon destiny, especially he, O chief of the Kurus, who wishes to rule.

sa: कृपः शारद्वतो राजन् नागानीकेन भारत। महामेघनिभेनाशु शिबियैव दुहुवे॥
en: Encircled by a large elephant force resembling a mass of clouds Saradvata's son Kripa quickly went towards his camp.

sa: पारिवित्त्यं त पतिते नास्ति प्रव्रजिते तथा। भिक्षिते पारदार्यं च तद् धर्मस्य न दूषकम्॥
en: If the elder brother is killed or has left the world, the younger brother does not commit sin by marrying. He who solicited by a woman, knows her commits no sin.

sa: श्रुत्वा च निहतं शल्यं धर्मपुत्रं च पीडितम्॥ मद्रराजप्रिये युक्तैर्मद्रकाणां महारथैः। आजगाम ततः पार्थो गाण्डीवं विक्षिपन् धनुः॥ पूरयन् रथघोषेण दिश: सर्वा महारथः।
en: In the meantime hearing that Shalya had been killed and that Yudhishthira had been assailed by the mighty car-warriors of the Madrakas devoted to the well-being of the Madraka king, the great car-warrior Partha came there, stretching his bow Gandiva and filling the Earth with the rattle of his car.

sa: त्वमेकः सुस्थितो राजन् स्वर्गे ते निलयो ध्रुवः॥ वयं नरकसंज्ञं वै दुःखं प्राप्स्याम दारुणम्।
en: You are, O king, departing from this world! You will surely go to heaven! We are, on the other hand, creatures of hell, and shall continue to suffer the bitterest grief?

sa: यत्र नास्ति शरैः कार्यं न मित्रैर्न च बन्धुभिः । आत्मनैकेन योद्धव्यं तत्ते युद्धमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Indeed, a battle is now before you in which there is no necessity of arrows, friends, of relatives and kinsmen, but which will have to be fought with your mind only.

sa: न कश्चिज्जात्वतिक्रामेज्जरामृत्यू हि मानवः। अपि सागरपर्यन्तां विजित्येमां वसुन्धराम्॥
en: No man can escape decrepitude and death, not even the conqueror of the whole Earth encompassed by the sea.

sa: तेषां तन्मतमाज्ञाय पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। अवहारं ततश्चक्रे शल्यस्यानुमते नृप।॥
en: Then the Kuru leaders anxiously desired to rally your troops and your son also tried to cheek their flight.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तोऽब्रवीद् द्रौणी राजानं युद्धदुर्मदम्। उत्तिष्ठ राजन् भद्रं ते विजेष्यामो वयं परान्॥
en: Sanjaya continued Thus addressed, the son of Drona replied to the king, who was invincible in battle, saying-"Rise up, O king, may you fare well. We shall yet defeat the enemy.

sa: सोपासङ्गः सरश्मिश्च साश्वः सयुगबन्धुरः। भस्मीभूतोऽपतद् भूमौ रथो गाण्डीवधन्वनः॥
en: Indeed, the car of Dhananjaya, with its quivers, reins, horses, yoke, and shaft, fell down, all reduced to ashes.

sa: वेदावाप्तिाह्मणस्येह दृष्टा रणे बलं क्षत्रियाणां जयो युधि। धनज्येष्ठाश्चापि भवन्स् िवैश्या: शूद्राऽऽरोग्यं प्राप्नुवन्तीह सर्वे॥
en: By reading it a Brahmana reaps the fruit of the Vedic studies, a Kshatriya obtains victory and strength in battle a Vaisya immense riches and Sudra health and immunity from ailments.

sa: स ततः सिंहतां नीतो नागेन्द्रो मुनिना तदा। वन्यं नागणयत् सिंहं तुल्यजातिसमन्वयात्॥ दृष्ट्वा च सोऽभवत् सिंहो वन्यो भयसमन्वितः। स चाश्रमेऽवसत् सिंहस्तस्मिन्नेव महावने।॥
en: Thereupon the sage metamorphosed that prince of elephants into a lion. As the wild lion was an animal of the same species with him, the Rishi's lion no longer feared him. On the other hand, seeing a stronger beast of his own species before him, the wild lion became afraid.

sa: हतोऽपि पुरुषव्याघ्र जीववानिव लक्ष्यते। नाभवद् विकृतिः काचिद्धतस्यापि महात्मनः॥
en: Although dead that best of men seemed ready to issue commands. Nothing was changed in that great heroes dead.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच राज्ञां वै परमो धर्म इति धर्मविदो विदुः। महान्तमेतं भारं च मन्ये तद् ब्रूहि पार्थिव॥
en: Yudhishthira said 'Persons conversant with duty and morality lecture that royal duties are the highest science of duty. I also regard the burden of those duties as being highly heavy. Do you, therefore, O king, describe those duties.

sa: एकादशचमूभर्ता पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। गदामादाय तेजस्वी पदातिः प्रस्थितो हृदम्॥
en: That lord of eleven Akshauhinis, viz., the energetic Duryodhana, taking up his mace, fled on foot towards a lake.

sa: धर्म विनश्यमानं हि यो न रक्षेत् स धर्महा। ते त्वया धर्महन्तारो निहताः सपदानुगाः॥
en: He who does not protect morality when it is being disregarded, is himself a trespasser of the same. The Kauravas transgressed morality. They have with their followers been killed by you.

sa: ततोऽहं समनुज्ञाप्य राजानं सहकेशवम्। प्रविष्टो हास्तिनपुरं रक्षन्ल्लोकान् प्रधावितान्॥
en: With the permission of king Yudhishthira and Keshava, I started for Hastinapura, for protecting the people thus flying away.

sa: धनंजयो रथानीकमभ्यवर्तत वीर्यवान्। माद्रीपुत्रौ तु शकुनि सात्यकिश्च महारथः॥ जवेनाभ्यपतन् हृष्टा नन्तो दौर्योधनं बलम्।
en: The energetic Dhananjaya Dhananjaya proceeded against the remaining car warriors of the Kuru away. Nakula, Sahadeva and Satyaki with great pleasure proceeded against Shakuni and killed the soldiers of Subala's son.

sa: अथाब्रवीद वासुदेवोऽपि पार्थं दृष्ट्वा रथेषून प्रतिहन्यमानान्॥ अमीमृदत् सर्वपातेऽद्य कर्णो ह्यस्त्रैरस्त्रं किमिदं भो किरीटिन्। स वीर किं मुह्यसि नावधत्से नदन्त्येते कुरवः सम्प्रहृष्टाः॥
en: Then Vasudeva seeing that Partha's shafts were being frustrated by Kama, addressed him (Arjuna)-How is this O Kiritin, that your weapons are being baffled by Karna. O brave warrior, why are you looking like one confounded. Don't you see the Kauravas, behind Karna, are all uttering loud shouts of joy.

sa: ततः सा तपसोगेण पीडयित्वाऽऽत्मनस्तनुम्॥ पितृदेवार्चनरता बभूव विजने वने।
en: Emaciating her body with austere penances, she began to worship the Pitris and the gods in that solitary forest.

sa: स वै शाकरसं दृष्ट्वा हर्षाविष्टः प्रनृत्तवान्। ततस्तस्मिन् प्रनृत्ते वै स्थावरं जङ्गमं च यत्॥
en: Seeing that vegetable juice, the Rishi was filled with joy and danced about there. Beholding him dance, all mobile and immobile creatures, O hero, overpowered by his energy, began to dance.

sa: यश्चैतेन प्रमाणेन योक्ष्यत्यात्मानमात्मना। स फलं सर्वपुण्यानां प्रेत्य चानुभविष्यति।॥
en: That person, who will follow the authority of your declarations, will obtain hereafter the meed of every meritorious act.

sa: ततस्तौ भृशसंक्रुद्धौ प्रध्माय सलिलौद्भवौ। समाहूय तदान्योन्यं भर्त्सयन्तौ समीयतुः॥
en: Both of them, in anger, blew their respective conchs. Returning and challenging each other, each then met the other.

sa: स्कन्दाय त्रीननुचरान् ददौ विष्णुर्महायशाः॥ वर्धनं नन्दनं चैव सर्वविद्याविशारदौ।
en: The Ashvins, O foremost of Bharatas gladly, gave Skanda two companions, viz., Vardhana and Nandana, masters of all sciences.

sa: समेत्य वीरा राजानं तदा त्वनुदिते रवौ। विप्रजग्मुर्महात्माो यथेच्छकमरिदमाः॥
en: Having met the king thus, those heroes, went away before the sunrise, O king, to the places they selected.

sa: शरान्धकारं सहसा कृतं तत्र समन्ततः। अभ्रच्छायेव संजज्ञे शरैर्मुक्तैर्महात्मभिः॥
en: Indeed, with the arrows shot by those illustrious warriors a shadow, like that of the clouds was caused there.

sa: तं पुत्रोऽप्येक एवैनमन्वयाचदमर्पणः। ततः प्रोवाच पुत्राय नातिहष्टमना इव॥
en: His only son also then begged it of him. Unwillingly he communicated the knowledge of that weapon to Ashvatthaman.

sa: विश्वासार्थं च सर्वेषां वर्णानामविशेषतः। तास्तथा समयं कृत्वा समयेनावतस्थिरे॥
en: For inspiring confidence among all classes of the people, they made such an agreement and lived for some time.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वारीन् विजयत भूत्वा संत्यागबुद्धयः। नरकस्याप्रतिष्ठस्य मा भूत वशवर्तिनः॥ त्यागमूलं हि शूराणां स्वर्गद्वारमनुत्तमम्।
en: Determined upon sacrificing your very lives, do you conquer your enemies! Do not fall into infamous hell! The sacrifice of life in battle forms the happy door of heaven for heroes!

sa: जघानानुचरैः सार्धं विविधायुधपाणिभिः। तथाकुर्वन्त विपुलं नादं वध्यत्सु शत्रुषु॥ कुमारानुचरा राजन् पूरयन्तो दिशो दश।
en: Filling the ten points of the horizon, the followers of Kumara, O king, made a loud noise, while those Daityas were being killed and danced and jumped and laughed in joy.

sa: प्राचेतसेन मनुना श्लोकौ चेमावुदाहृतौ। राजधर्मेषु राजेन्द्र ताविहैकमनाः शृणु।॥
en: Manu, the son of Prachetas, recited these two verses regarding the duties of kings. Listen to them with attention.

sa: सर्वकामसमृद्धं च तदाश्रमपदं महत्। मुनिभिर्ब्राह्मणैश्चैव सेवितं सर्वदा विभो॥
en: That great hermitage is capable of fructifying every wish. It always, O lord, the asylum of ascetics and Brahmanas.

sa: एकार्णवां महीं कृत्वा रुधिरेण परिप्लुताम्। जघ्नुर्दैत्यांस्तथा देवास्त्रिदिवं चाभिलेभिरे॥
en: Converting the Earth to one vast sea of blood, the gods killed the Daityas and occupied the celestial region.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमसेनोऽथ सात्यकिः। सहदेवश्च माद्रेयो मद्रराजमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Then king Yudhishthira, Bhimasena, Satyaki and Sahadeva the son of Madri, all rushed against the king of the Madras.

sa: यथा विष्णुमयं सत्यं यथा विष्णुमयं जगत्। यथा विष्णुमयं सर्वं पाप्मा मे नश्यतां तथा॥
en: As Truth is full of Vishnu, as the universe is full of Vishnu, as everything full of Vishnu, so let my soul be full of Vishnu, and my sins be dissipated.

sa: गजानां पार्थ वर्माणि गोवृषाजगराणि च। शल्यकण्टकलोहानि तनुत्रचमराणि च॥ सितपीतानि शस्त्राणि संनाहाः पीतलोहिताः। नानारञ्जनरक्ताः स्युः पताका: केतवश्च ह॥ ऋश्यस्तोमराः खड्गा निशिताश्च परश्वधाः। फलकान्यथ चर्माणि प्रतिकल्प्यान्यनेकशः॥
en: Leathern armour for protecting the bodies of elephants, as also those for bulls, bones, thorns, and keen-pointed iron weapons, coats of mail, yak-tails, sharp and well-tempered weapons, all kinds of armour yellow and red, banners and standards of various colours, swords, lances, sharp scimitars, battle axes, spears and shields should be manufactured and kept profusely in store.

sa: स काञ्चनविचित्राङ्गमारुरोह महारथम्॥ आदाय रुचिरं चित्रं समार्गणगुणं धनुः।
en: He got upon his great golden car, and took his beautiful bow with its arrow fixed on the string.

sa: त्रयोदश समास्तीर्णा जागरेण सुदुःखिताः। स्वप्स्यामोऽद्य सुखं रात्रौ त्वत्प्रसादान्महाभुज॥
en: Thirteen years we have spent in misery and vigilance. By your favour we will now sleep peacefully in night."

sa: भीष्म उवाच यस्मिन् भयादितः सम्यक् क्षेमं विन्दत्यपि क्षणम्। स स्वर्गजित्तमोऽस्माकं सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Bhishma said That man, from whom a person assailed by fear obtains even a momentary relief, deserves heaven from amongst the best of us. What I tell you is very true.

sa: श्लाघते त्वां हि वार्ष्णेयो राजसंसत्सु भारत। स शिष्यो मम कौरव्यो गदायुद्ध इति प्रभो॥
en: The Vrishni hero in mace fight, O Bharata, used to boast of you, O lord, in every assembly. Saying, Duryodhana, of the race of Kuru, is a worthy disciple of mine.

sa: अङ्गारकुशमुजानां पलाशशरवर्णिनाम्। यवसेन्धनादिग्धानां कारयीत च संचयान्॥ आयुधानां च सर्वेषां शक्त्य॒श्विासवर्मणाम्। संचयानेवमादीनां कारयीत नराधिपः॥
en: And charcoal and munja grass, leaves, arrows, scribes and draftsmen, grass, fuel, poisoned arrows, weapons of all sorts such as darts, swords, lances and others, The king should store such articles.

sa: शक्तः स्यात् सुसुखो राजा कुर्यात् करणमापदि। प्रियो भवति भूतानां न च विभ्रश्यते श्रियः॥
en: The king should show his power, live merrily, and do what is necessary in times of danger. Such a king is loved of all creatures and never falls away from prosperity.

sa: ततो ज्यां विनिधायान्यामभिमन्त्र्य च पाण्डवः। शरैरवाकिरत् कर्ण दीप्यमानैरिवाहिभिः॥
en: Then setting another string to his bow and shooting innumerable shafts, Arjuna covered Karna with arrows resembly fiery-mouthed serpents.

sa: उक्ता ह्यनेन पाञ्चाली सभायां द्यूतनिर्जिता। प्रियं चिकीर्षता भ्रातुः कर्णस्य च जनार्दन॥ सहैव सहदेवेन नकुलेनार्जुनेन च। दासीभूतासि पाञ्चालि क्षिप्रं प्रविश नो गृहान्॥
en: Addressing the princess of Panchala, in the midst of the assembly, who had been won by dice, this Dusshasana, desirous of pleasing his (elder) brother and Karna, O Janarddana, had said,-You are now the wife of a slave! With Sahadeva and Nakula and Arjuna, O lady, enter our household now.

sa: तथा विराटनगरे कीचकेन भृशार्दिताम्॥ मामप्युद्धृतवान् कृच्छ्रात् पौलोमी मघवानिव।
en: Like Indra rescuing his wife, the daughter of Puloma, you saved me in Virata's city, from a great danger.

sa: उदतिष्ठत पुत्रस्ते प्रतपन् रश्मिवानिव। ततः शैक्यायसीं गुर्वी जातरूपपरिष्कृताम्॥
en: Highly powerful your intelligent son began to handle his heavy mace made of iron and equipt with a sling.

sa: कृच्छ्रादुत्सारयन्ति स्म गृध्रगोमायुवायसान्। दुःखेनार्ता विघूर्णन्त्यो मत्ता इव चरन्त्युत॥
en: Reeling in sorrow, they are moving about like drunk persons, driving away with difficulty vulture and jackals and crows.

sa: अश्वरोहास्तु संरब्धाः पाण्डवानां तरस्विनाम्। प्राविशन् सौबलानीकमभ्यतिक्रम्य तान् रथान्॥
en: The horsemen, beside themselves with rage, of the Pandavas penetrated the division of Subala's son, overpowering the latter's carwarriors.

sa: हतामित्रामिमामुर्वीमनुशाधि महाभुजा यत्तो भूत्वा सहास्माभिर्भुडक्ष्व भोगांश्च पुष्कलान्॥ २३
en: O Heroe, rule now vigilantly the earth shorn of your enemies and enjoy with us all pleasures of life.

sa: व्यवस्थापयति क्षिप्रमिमं लोकं नरेश्वर। सत्ये व्यवस्थितो धर्मो ब्राह्मणेष्ववतिष्ठते॥
en: Punishment, o king, quickly sets the world on the path of righteousness. Depend upon truth, righteousness exits in Brahmanas.

sa: अद्य सैन्यानि पाण्डूनां द्रावयिष्ये समन्ततः॥ द्रोणभीष्मावति विभो सूतपुत्रं च संयुगे। विचरिष्ये रणे युध्यन् प्रियार्थं तव कौरव॥
en: Today I will disperse the troops of the Pandavas on all sides. Excelling Drona and Bhishma and the son of Suta, O lord, in battle, I will move about the field, O Kourava, for doing what pleases you.

sa: त्रयीं च नाम वार्ता च त्यक्त्वा पुत्रान् व्रजन्ति ये। त्रिविष्टब्धं च वासश्च प्रतिगृह्णन्त्यबुद्धयः॥
en: They who, casting off the three Vedas, their usual avocations and children, live like mendicants by taking up the triple-headed rod and the brown robe, are really persons of weak understanding.

sa: हरेत् तद् द्रविणं राजन् धार्मिकः पृथिवीपतिः। ततः प्रीणयते लोकं न कोशं तद्विधं नृपः॥
en: O king, A virtuous ruler, should appropriate such riches. By that wealth, a large number of good people can be pleased. He should not, however, amass that wealth in his treasury.

sa: विभाति कर्णः समरे विशाम्पते। महीरुहैराचितसानुकन्दरो यथा गिरीन्द्रः स्फुटकर्णिकारवान्॥
en: His body covered with numberless arrows Karna shone like the mountain-chief covered with trees or adorned with blossoming Karnikaras.

sa: देवलो दर्शयन्नेव नैवायुञ्जत धर्मतः। एवं तयोर्महाराज दीर्घकालो व्यतिक्रमत्॥
en: Indeed, while the great Muni Jaigishavya lived there, Devala always paid him attention, never neglecting him at any time.

sa: न विक्रमो न चाप्यर्थो न मित्रं न सुहृज्जनः। तथोन्मोचयते दुःखाद् यथाऽऽत्मा स्थिरसंयमः॥ तस्मान्मैत्रं समास्थाय शीलमापद्य भारत।
en: Neither power, nor riches, nor friends, nor well-wishers, can cure a man of his grief so successfully as the control of self. Therefore not injuring others and cherishing friendship for all creatures, be of pious behaviour, O Bharata!

sa: संजयस्याथ राजर्षेः कस्मिंश्चित् कालपर्यये। जज्ञे पुत्रो महावीर्यस्तेजसा प्रज्वलन्निव॥
en: After some time had passed, the royal sage Srinjaya had born unto him a highly powerful and energetic son.

sa: नरश्चेत्कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं चाप्यनुष्ठितः। संशयं लभते किंचित् तेन राजा विगीते॥
en: If a person engaged in agriculture, cattletending, or trade, feels a sense of insecurity, the king, incirs infamy thereby.

sa: अल्पावशेषोऽपि कृतो महात्मा शरीरभक्षैः परिभक्षयद्भिः। द्रष्टुं न नः प्रीतिकरः शशीव कृष्णस्य पक्षस्य चतुर्दशाहे॥
en: Feasting on the body of that illustrious hero, carnivorous animals, have reduced it greatly. This spectacle is indeed pitiable, like that of the moon on the fourteenth night of the darkfortnight.

sa: उमा ददौ विरजसी वाससी रविसप्रभे॥ गङ्गा कमण्डलुं दिव्यममृतोद्भवमुत्तमम्।
en: With great pleasure Ganga gave Kumara a celestial water-pot, begotten of ambrosia and Brihaspati gave him a sacred stick.

sa: ततस्तु निशितैर्बाणैस्तवानीकं वृकोदरः॥ इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शः : समन्तात् पर्यवाकिरत्। ततः क्षणेन तद् भीमो न्यहनद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: With keen arrows Vrikodara, however, whose touch resembled that of Indra's thunder, enshrouded the army around him. Within a very short time, Bhima killed them all, O foremost of Bharata's race.

sa: भीष्म उवाच मातापित्रोर्गुरूणां च पूजा बहुमता मम। इह युक्तो नरो लोकान् यशश्च महदश्नुते॥
en: Bhishma said The adoration of mother, father, and preceptor is, I consider, the most important. The man, who satisfies that duty here, succeeds in winning great fame and many blessed regions.

sa: अकायश्चाल्पसारश्च वेतसः कूलजश्च वः। अवज्ञया वा नानीतः किं च वा तेन वः कृतम्॥
en: The canes that grow on your banks have small stems and are not strong. Do you refuse to wash them down through contempt, or are they of any utility to you?

sa: न ह्येवं मित्रकार्याणि प्रीत्या कुर्वन्ति साधवः। यथा त्वं मोक्षितः कृच्छ्रात् त्वरमाणेन वै मया॥
en: I saved you from a great danger with considerable promptness. Alas, honest persons never thus do the business of their friends. Filled with joy while doing it, they do it otherwise.

sa: तयोर्युद्धं महाराज चिरं सममिवाभवत्॥ शस्त्राणां सङ्गमश्चैव घोरस्तत्राभवत् पुनः।
en: The battle between them, O king, was equally fought for a long while. The din of weapons was horrible.

sa: न ब्रह्मचारी चरणादयेतो यदा ब्रह्म ब्रह्मणि त्राणमिच्छेत्। आश्चर्यतो वर्षति तत्र देव स्तत्राभीक्ष्णं दुःसहाश्चाविशन्ति॥
en: When Brahmanas neglect the study of the Vedas and seek protection from the scriptures, then Indra does not pour rain in time and various sorts of calamities constantly assail the kingdom.

sa: स पूजामृषिभिर्दत्तां सम्प्रगृह्य नराधिपः। अपृच्छत् तापसान् सर्वांस्तपसो वृद्धिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Accepting the honours offered by the Rishis, the king asked them about the progress and advancement to their penances.

sa: सुखं च दुःखं च भवाभवौ च लाभालाभौ मरणं जीवितं च। पर्यायतः सर्वमवाप्नुवन्ति तस्माद्धीरो नैव हृष्येन शोचेत्॥
en: Happiness and misery, prosperity and adversity, gain and loss, death and life, in their turn, visit all creatures. There the wise man, endued with equanimity soul would neither be puffed up with joy nor be depressed with sorrow.

sa: य एष पद्मरक्ताक्षः पीतवासा महाभुजः। सुहृद् भ्राता च मित्रं च सम्बन्धी च तथाच्युतः॥
en: This Krishna here, having eyes red as the lotus, clad in yellow attire, possessed of mighty arms,—this Krishna, who is our well-wisher, brother, friend, and relative, is Narayana of undecaying glory.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽपि समरे प्रगृह्य परमायुधम्॥ राजानं योधयामास पश्यतां सर्वधन्विनाम्।
en: Then, in that battle, having taken up a formidable bow, Dhrishtadyumna fought with the king before all the bowmen.

sa: एते गोमायवो भीमा निहतानां यशस्विनाम्। कण्ठान्तरगतान् हारानाक्षिपन्ति सहस्रशः॥
en: There, thousands of fierce wolves, are dragging the golden chains sound the necks of many illustrious but dead heroes.

sa: तां वृत्तिं नानुवर्तेत विजीगीषुर्महीपतिः। धर्मलब्धाद्धि विजयाल्लाभः कोऽभ्यधिको भवेत्॥
en: A king, desirous of winning victory, should never behave thus. What gain can be greater than victory won fairly.

sa: यस्य प्रसादाद् बीभत्सुः पाण्डव: कर्म दुष्करम्। चकार स हतः शेते नैनमस्त्राण्यपालयन्॥ धर्मेषु कुरवः
en: Through his favour, Vibhatsu the son of Pandu has achieved the most of difficult feats. He now lies dead on the ground. Weapons refused to come at last at his command.

sa: हृष्टानि व्यनदनुच्चैर्मुदा भरतसत्तम। स शब्दः पूरितो राजन् भूतसंधैर्मुदायुतैः॥
en: That loud noise, O king, of the ghostly beings, filled all the points of the horizon and the sky.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणुष्वावहितो राजन् धर्मगुह्यानि भारत। यथा हि भगवान् व्यासः पुरा कथितवान् मयि॥
en: Bhishma said Listen to me with rapt attention, O king, as I explain to you, O Bharata, these mysteries of duties as the holy Vyasa had explained them to me formerly.

sa: तं प्रयान्तं महाबाहुमनुज्ञाप्य महाबलम्। पर्यवर्तन्त ते सर्वे वृकस्थलनिवासिनः॥
en: All those residents of Vrikasthala returned after duly informing the greatly powerful one, who was departing (for the city).

sa: भीष्म उवाच संवादं इत्ययं श्रेष्ठः साध्यानां परिकीर्तितः। क्षेत्रं वै कर्मणां योनिः सद्भावः सत्यमुच्यते॥
en: Bhishma said Thus have I recited to you the excellent discourse between the Saddhyas (and the Swan). The body is the origin of acts, and existence or individual Soul is truth.

sa: सूक्ष्मं तपस्तत् परमं त्वमेव परावरज्ञोऽसि परावरस्त्वम्। धर्मस्य कामस्य परस्य चैव त्वत्तेजसा कृत्स्त्रमिदं महात्मन्॥
en: You are the personation of virtue. Being yourself both vast and minute, you are acquainted with the highest and the lowest points of virtuous acts, you are the mysteries of Brahma.

sa: धिग्वाचा परिहासोऽपि मम वा मद्विधस्य वा। मृत्युनाभ्यधिकः सौते स त्वं मा व्यपयाः पुनः॥
en: O son of Suta, ridicule with the exclamation of fie is to me or to a person like me is more than dcath. Thereupon never again leave the field of battle.
