sa: इति कुन्ती विनिश्चित्य कार्यनिश्चयमुत्तमम्। कार्यार्थमभिनिश्चित्य ययौ भागीरथी प्रति॥
en: Kunti, thus thinking on an excellent course of action, went towards the Bhagirathi for the attainment of her objects.

sa: तत्रापरे वध्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुरचेतसः॥ शिविरान् निष्पतन्ति स्म क्षत्रिया भयपीडिताः।
en: While being killed, other Kshatriyas lost their senses, and, stricken with fear, tried to fly away from the camps.

sa: जलजानि च सत्त्वानि दह्यमानानि भारत। न शान्तिमुपजग्मुर्हि तप्यमानैर्जलाशयैः॥
en: The watery expouses being heated, the acquatic creatures, scorched with the heat, O Bharata, could not find any ease.

sa: शोभन्तो रथिनां श्रेष्ठाः सहसैन्यपदानुगाः। संयत्तः समरे वीरा भीमसेनमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Those foremost of car-warriors, those heroes and their following troops fighting heedfully and falling upon Bhimasena appeared highly beautiful.

sa: सर्वत्र च दयावन्तः सन्तः करुणवेदिनः॥ गच्छन्तीह सुसंतुष्टा धर्मपन्थानमुत्तमम्। शिष्टाचाराः महात्मानो येषां धर्मः सुनिश्चितः॥
en: Who are kind on all occasions and who are filled with compassion, obtain the greatest contentment and ascend the superior path of virtue; and whose acquisition of virtue is most certain.

sa: सोऽथ विप्रर्षभः सर्वं कृत्वा कार्यं यथाविधि। देवान्वाग्भिः पितॄनद्भिस्तर्पयित्वाजगाम ह। यत्र ब्रह्मर्षयः सिद्धाः सुखासीना धृतव्रताः। यज्ञायतनमाश्रित्य सूतपुत्रपुरःसराः॥
en: The best of Brahmanas (Shaunaka) after having performed all his Prayers to Devas and the Pitris by offering water, came back to the place of sacrifice where Sauti was seated before the assembly of Rishis of rigid vows.

sa: तस्या रजन्यास्त्वर्धन पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्। गमयामास राजेन्द्र द्रौणिर्थमनिवेशनम्॥
en: Before half the night was over, the son of Drona, O king, killed the large army of the Pandavas.

sa: ते शरैर्भीमकर्माणं ववर्षः पाण्डवं युधि। मेघा इवातपापाये धाराभिर्धरणीधरम्॥
en: Thus slaughtered by the puissant Bhima, your sons, O mighty monarch. Once more surrounded Bhima that foremost of smiters,

sa: दैतेयान् दानवांश्चैव कलिरप्याविशत् ततः। तानलक्ष्मीसमाविष्टान् दानवान् कलिना हतान्॥
en: Then Kali possessed the Daityas and the Danavas. Being thus possessed by adversity, the Danavas were destroyed by Kali.

sa: तथान्येषां च यक्षाणां भूतानां पतयश्च ये। कृसरेण च मांसेन निवापैस्तिलसंयुतैः॥ ओदनं कुम्भशः कृत्वा पुरोधाः समुपाहरत्। ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सहस्राणि गवां दत्त्वा तु भूमिपः॥
en: To the other Yakshas also and to them who were the foremost ones among the ghostly companions of Mahadeva, the priest offered due adoration, having filled many jugs with food, with Krisharas and meat and Nivapas mixed with sesame seeds. The king gave away unto the Brahmanas thousands of kine.

sa: मृदङ्गभेरीशङ्खानां स्तनयित्नो रथस्य च। यः कश्चिच्छ्रयते शब्दः प्राणिनोऽप्राणिनोऽपि वा। एतेषामेव सर्वेषां विषये सम्प्रकीर्तितः॥
en: Whatever sound is heard from small and large drums and conch-shells, and cloucis, and cars, and animate and inanimates creatures, are all contained in these seven sorts of sound already mentioned.

sa: न त केवलदैवेन प्रजा भावेन रेमिरे। यद् बभूव मन:कान्तं कर्मणा स चकार तत्॥
en: The people took delight in him, not only because he was their king, but because they bore for him a great affection. The king also did not was agreeable to them.

sa: त्र्यहं स्नातंः स भवति निराहारश्च वर्तते। स्पृशते यो गवां पृष्ठं बालधिं च नमस्यति॥
en: By so doing he becomes purged off of all his sins like the Moon freed from Rahu. He should thus bathe for three days successively and then fast for every day.

sa: किं त्वस्ति मम संदेहो गवां लोकं प्रति प्रभो। तत्त्वतः श्रोतुमिच्छामि गोदा यत्र वसन्त्युत॥
en: I have, however one doubt. About the regions of kine. I wish to hear particularly about those regions which are reserved for the residence of persons who make gifts of kine.

sa: अन्ये हि सुमहाभागा बलवन्तो दुरुत्सहाः। नित्योत्थानेन सम्पन्ना नारदान्धकवृष्णयः॥
en: Many others among the Andhakas and the Vrishnis are endued with great prosperity, might, daring courage and constant perseverance.

sa: स तान् प्रमृद्याभ्यपतत् पुनरेव युधिष्ठिरम्। मन्त्रौषधिक्रियातीतो व्याधिरत्युल्बणौ यथा॥
en: Grinding all those combatants Karna once more rushed upon Yudhishthira like irresistible disease unchecked by incantations, drugs and rites.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। संवादं वासुदेवस्य सुरर्षेर्नारदस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old history of a discourse between Vasudeva and the divine saint Narada.

sa: अथाभ्यगच्छद्गोविन्दो वृष्णिभिः सह धर्मजम्। बलदेवं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वप्राणभृतां वरः॥
en: The foremost of all men, viz., Govinda, came there, accompanied by the Vrishnis, and with Baladeva in the van.

sa: तं शयानं महात्मानं विश्रब्धमकुतोभयम्॥ प्राबोधयत पादेन शयनस्थं महीपते।
en: Having received a kick from Ashvatthaman the high-souled prince who was sleeping trustfully and fearlessly on his bed, awoke.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच किमिदं रोदिषि शुभे कच्चित् क्षेमं दिवौकसाम्। मानुषेष्वथ वा गोषु नैतदल्पं भविष्यति॥
en: Indra said: O blessed one, why do you weep? Is everything well with the celestials? Has any misfortune, however so little, befallen on the world of men or of the Nagas.

sa: उत बालाय पाण्डित्यं पण्डितायोत बालताम्। ददाति सर्वमीशानः पुरस्ताच्छुक्रमुच्चरन्॥
en: The supreme lord gives wisdom to the child and childishness to the wise, developing the seed in a being.

sa: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञामश्वत्थामा महाबलः। धनुः प्रपीड्य वामेन करेणामित्रकर्शनः॥
en: Regaining his consciousness, that grinder of foes, the mighty car-warriors Ashvatthama, drawing powerfully his bow with the left hand.

sa: अभ्यद्रवत् राधेयं प्रवपन् सायकान् बहून्। चक्ररक्षावपि तदा युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ॥
en: (Satyaki) discharging numerous. arrows, rushed upon the son of Radha. Then Yudhamanyu and Uttamouja, the protectors of Arjuna's car-wheels.

sa: कबन्धः परिघाभासो दृश्यते भास्करान्तिके॥ जग्राह सूर्यं स्वर्भानुरपर्वणि महाग्रहः। प्रवाति मारुतः शीघ्रं निष्प्रभौऽभूद् दिवाकरः॥
en: And comets, resembling parighas appeared beside the sun. That mighty planet Svarbhānu seized the sun when there was no parva. And the winds blew violently; and the sun was without lustre.

sa: एवं मधुर्वरं लब्ध्वा देवात्सुमहदद्भुतम्। भवनं सोऽसुरश्रेष्ठः कारयामास सुप्रभम्॥
en: Having obtained this wonderful boon from the god, Madhu, foremost of Asuras, caused a splendid city to be constructed.

sa: मदिराश्वश्च राजर्षिर्दत्त्वा कन्यां सुमध्यमाम्। हिरण्यहस्ताय गतो लोकान् देवैरधिष्ठितान्॥
en: The Royal Sage Madirashva went to the region of the celestials by giving his slender waisted daughter to Hiranyahasta.

sa: द्वादश्यां कार्तिके मासि पूज्य दामोदरेति च। गवां यज्ञमवाप्नोति पुमान् स्त्री वा न संशयः॥
en: By observing a fast for the twelfth day of the moon in the month of Kartika and adoring Krishna as Damodara, one acquires forsooth, the combined merits of all the sacrifices.

sa: एते सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। अभिवाद्य महात्मानमर्चन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम्॥
en: All these celestials headed by Indra, Siddhas and Great saints, bowing to this high-souled and excellent Purusa, worship him.

sa: सृष्टः शरोऽयं काकुत्स्थ यदा शेते महार्णवे। स्वयंभूरजितो दिव्यो यं नापश्यन्सुरासुराः॥ अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां तेनायं हि शरोत्तमः। सृष्टः क्रोधाभिभूतेन विनाशार्थ दुरात्मनोः॥ मधुकैटभयोर्वीर विघाते सर्वरक्षसाम्। स्रष्टुकामेन लोकांस्त्रीस्तौ चानेन हतौ युधि ॥ हत्वा जनभोगार्थे कैटभं तु मधुं तथा। अनेन शरमुख्येन ततो लोकांश्चकार सः॥
en: O Kākutstha, this shaft was forged when invisible by celestials and Asuras the divine selfsprung and invincible (deity) reposed on the mighty main, and when creation was oppressed by Madhu and Kaitabha as well as other Räks asas. He, overwhelmed with rage desirous of creating the three worlds, created the best of arrows invincible to all beings, for the extraction of the wicked ones; and destroyed them in battle by means of this very arrow. And having with this foremost of shafts finished Madhu and Kait abha, they set about creating the worlds.

sa: कल्की विष्णुयशा नाम द्विजः कालप्रचोदितः। उत्पत्स्यते महावीर्यो महाबुद्धिपराक्रमः॥
en: Impelled by Time a Brahmana named Kalki Vishnuyasha will be born. He will possess great energy, intelligence and prowess.

sa: महास्कन्धो महोरस्को महाबाहुर्महाहनुः। महाबलो महावीर्यः स महात्मा महारथः॥
en: That high-souled and mighty car-warriors possesses broad shoulders, bread chest, long arms, large jaws, great strength and unrivalled prowess.

sa: अजय्यं वासुदेवस्य रथमास्थाय सात्यकिः। विरथं कृतवान् कर्ण वासुदेवसमो युधि॥ दारुकेण समायुक्तः स्वबाहुबलदर्पितः। कचिदन्यं समारूढः सात्यकि: शत्रुतापनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Mounting the invincible of Vasudeva, guided by Daruka, Satyaki, proud of the prowess of his arms and equal to Vasudeva in battle, made Karna carless. Did Satyaki ascend any other car (after the defeat of Karna)?

sa: कर्ण संशप्तकांश्चैव पार्थस्यामित्रघातिनः॥ अमन्यत वधे युक्तान् समर्थांश्च सुयोधनः।
en: Duryodhana considered that Karna and the Samshaptaka army were both able to kill that chastiser of foes Partha (Arjuna).

sa: पत्यौ स्त्री तु तदा राजन् पुरुषो वा स्त्रियं प्रति। युगान्ते राजशार्दूल न तोषमुपयास्यति॥
en: O king, O foremost of monarchs, when this age would come the wife will not remain content with her husband and the husband also will not remain content with his wife.

sa: दीप्तपावकसंकाशो द्युतिमान् समरध्वजः॥ अपविद्धश्च भग्नश्च कस्य साङ्ग्रामिको रथः।
en: Whose is this shattered war-car lying upset on the ground and broken flag resembling in lustre the burning gold?

sa: इन्द्रस्तु मेषवृषणस्तदाप्रभृति राघव। गौतमस्य प्रभावेण तपसा च महात्मनः॥
en: Thenceforth, O Rāghava, Indra also through the high-souled Gautama's ascetic energy, has been bearing the scrotum of a ram.

sa: पुरु उवाच चिकित्सायां प्रचरतु भार्यया चैव पुष्यतु। श्वशुरात्तस्य वृत्तिः स्याद् यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Puru said Let him who has stolen your stalks practise as a physician! Let him be supported by the earnings of his wife! Let him draw his maintenance from his fatherinlaw!

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तु निर्विण्णस्तेन गन्धेन मूर्च्छितः। निवर्तने धृतमनाः पर्यावर्तत भारत॥
en: Yudhishthira, however sorely disconsolate and stupefied by the foul stench. Resolved to return, O Bharata, he retraced his steps.

sa: दीर्धेभ्यश्च मनुष्येभ्यः प्रमाणादधिको भुवि। स स्वैरं चरते लोकान् ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः॥ इमां गाथां गायमानश्चत्वरेषु सभासु च। दुर्वाससं वासयेत् को ब्राह्मणं सत्कृतं गृहे।॥
en: He was taller in stature than the tallest man on Earth. Wandering over all the worlds of human beings and of the deities and other superior beings, he sang constantly among assemblies and in public squares. Who is there who would cause the Brahmana Durvasas to live in his house, doing the duties of hospitality towards him?

sa: तस्य शृङ्गमुपारुह्य बहुरत्नाचितं शुभम्। अनन्तकल्पमुद्विद्धं सुरा: सर्वे महौजसः।॥
en: It stands high for infinite ages. Once did the celestials sit on its golden summit and held a conclave.

sa: वधं प्राप्तं तु माद्रेयं नावधीत् समरेऽरिहा। कुन्त्याः स्मृत्वा वचो राजन् सत्यसंधो महायशाः।। २०
en: Remembering the words of Kunti, that mighty car-warrior and slayer of foes in battle, firm in truth, did not, O king, slay the son of Madri though he could do so.

sa: अरुन्धती उवाच श्वश्र्वापवाद वदतु भर्तुर्भवतु दुर्मनाः। एका स्वादु समश्नातु या ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Arundhati said Let her who has stolen your stalks speak ill of her motherinlaw. Let her dislike her husband. Let her eat alone any good food that comes to her house.

sa: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय माद्रीपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। कर्णं विव्याध विंशत्या तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Thereupon the puissant son of Madri taking up another bow, pierced Karna with twenty shafts and this appeared wonderful.

sa: अनादिष्टस्तु गुरुणा को नु युध्येत मानवः। आदिष्टस्तु यथा राजन् को न युध्येत मादृशः॥
en: Unless commanded by his preceptors, what man goes to battle with his enemies? When again commanded, O king, like myself, by his preceptors, what man is there that would not fight?

sa: हयौघांश्च रथौघांश्च गजौघांश्च महारथः। अपातयद् रणे राजशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: That mighty car-warrior felled in battle, O monarch, large divisions of steeds, car-warriors and elephants, by hundreds and thousands.

sa: स देवलोकस्य तमो निहत्य सूर्यो यथा राहुमुखाद्विमुक्तः। तथा व्याभासीद्धरिसैन्यमध्ये निहत्य रामो युधि कुम्भकर्णम्॥
en: Like to the Sun emerged from the mouth of Rāhu, and destroying the darkness of the celestial fields, shone Rāma in the midst of the monkey-army having slain Kumbhakarņa in battle.

sa: महत्या सेनया युक्तो दुर्योधनमुपागमत्। राक्षसानां विरूपाणां सहस्रः परिवारितः॥
en: Supported by a large division of troops and surrounded by thousands of Rakshasas of dreadful aspect, he approached Duryodhana.

sa: शिखण्डिनं द्वादशभिर्विंशत्या चोत्तमौजसम्। नकुलं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा सहदेवं च सप्तभिः॥ युधिष्ठिरं द्वादशभिद्रौपदेयांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः। सात्यकि पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा मत्स्यं च दशभिः शरैः॥
en: Piercing Sikhandin with twelve arrows, Uttamaujas with twenty, Nakula with five and Sahadeva with seven. Yudhishthira with twelve and the sons of Draupadi each with three, Satyaki with five and the ruler of the Matsyas with ten arrows.

sa: दृष्टवीर्यस्तु काकुत्स्थो जनकेन महात्मना। सम्प्रदानं सुतायास्तु राघवे कर्तुमिच्छति॥
en: And the high-souled Janaka has witnessed the prowess of Kākutstha; and he wish to bestow his daughter upon Rāghava.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च विराटो द्रुपदस्तथा। भीष्ममासाद्य समरे शरैर्जघ्नुर्महारथम्॥
en: Then Dhrishtadyumna, Shikhandin, Virata and Draupada, encountering Bhishma in battle began to pierce that mighty car-warriors with numerous shafts.

sa: अवद्विांश्चैव विद्वांश्च ब्राह्मणो दैवतं महत्। प्रणीतश्चाप्रणीतश्च यथाग्निर्दैवतं महत्॥
en: Learned or unlearned, the Brahmana is always a great deity. Purified or not, Fire is ever a great god.

sa: कस्त्वेतद् व्यवसेदार्यस्त्वदन्यः पुरुषाधम॥ निगृह्य केशेषु वधं गुरोर्धर्मात्मनः सतः।
en: What other sinful wretch, except yourself, will dare cause the virtuous preceptor's death, holding him by his hoary locks?

sa: रञ्जिताश्चामरा युक्तास्तव कर्ण महारथे॥ प्रवराः प्रज्वलन्त्येते ध्वजश्चैव प्रकम्पते।
en: O Karna, the coloured chowries attached to your huge car are waving roughly and your pennon is also trembling.

sa: अलं ते व्यपदेशेन प्रमाणा यदि ते वयम्। प्रयच्छ कुण्डले मह्यं सत्यवाग् भव पार्थिव॥
en: Utanka said If we be considered as any authority, do you cease then to urge this pretext. Do you give those jewelled ear-rings to me. Be truthful in speech, O king.

sa: स ता गिरः पुरस्ताद् वै श्रुतपूर्वा पुनः पुनः। ग्लानानां दुःखितानां च नाभ्यजानत पाण्डवः॥
en: The words of those woe-begone and afflicted persons seemed to the son of Pandu to be uttered in voices that he had heard before although he could not, then recognise thein.

sa: अचिरेण तु कालेन परिवाहान् बहूदकान्। चक्रुर्बहुविधाकारान् सागरप्रतिमान् बहून्॥
en: In a short time, they made places poor of water overflow with many and various expanses resembling the ocean.

sa: तौ प्रगृह्य महावेगे धनुषी भीमनिःस्वने॥ प्राच्छादयतामन्योन्यं तक्षमाणौ महेषुभिः।
en: Each then grasping a fearful bow of loud twang began to wound and cover the other with mighty shafts.

sa: कौतूहलात् कण्टकेन बुद्धिमोहबलात्कृता। किं नु खल्विदमित्युक्त्वा निर्बिभेदास्य लोचने॥
en: Out of curiosity she lost her sense; and saying "what is this,” she pierced the eyes with a thorn.

sa: कूपमध्ये च या जाता वल्ली यत्र स मानवः। प्रताने लम्बते लग्नो जीविताशा शरीरिणाम्॥
en: The cluster of creepers growing in that pit and by whose spreading stems the man hangs down is the man hangs down is the desire for life which every creature entertains.

sa: द्राविडाः सिंहलाश्चैव राजा काश्मीरकस्तथा। कुन्तिभोजो महातेजाः पार्थिवो गौरवाहनः॥
en: And of the Dravidas and the Singhalas, the king of Kashmira, the greatly effulgent king Kuntibhoja, the king Gauravahana.

sa: आर्येणेव परिक्रुष्टं लक्ष्मणेति सुविस्वरम्। परित्राहीति यद्वाक्यं मैथिल्यास्तच्छ्रुतिं गतम्॥
en: The cries of O Laksimana, save me, as if uttered by the master, came to the ears of Maithili.

sa: तत्र दृष्ट्वैव तां हर्षादिन्द्रियाणि चकम्पिरे। स कामवशमापन्नः सौमित्रिमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: And beholding there that lake, his senses were stirred with delight. Troubled with passion he spoke to Saumitri saying,

sa: दृष्ट्वाचेष्टमानं तु भूमौ मृगकलवरम्। स्नात्वाऽऽगच्छत भद्रं वोरक्षामीत्याह जम्बुकः॥
en: The Jackal said, “ Blessed be you! Go and perform your ablutions. I shall look after it (the deer)".

sa: व्याघ्र उवाच किं शोचसि महाप्राज्ञ त्वं नो बुद्धिमतां वरः। अशित्वा पिशितान्यद्य विहरिष्यामहे वयम्॥
en: The Tiger said : O greatly wise one, what are you pondering over? You are the foremost of all intelligent persons. Let us enjoy ourselves (now) by feasting on this carcass.

sa: व्याघ्र उवाच ब्रवीति यदि स ह्येवं काले ह्यस्मिन् प्रबोधितः। स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य हनिष्येऽहं वनेचरान्॥ खादिष्ये तत्र मांसानि इत्युक्त्वा प्रस्थितो वनम्। एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु मूषिकोऽप्याजगाम ह॥ तमागतमभिप्रेत्य शृगालोऽप्यब्रववीद् वचः।
en: The Tiger said: If the mouse has really said this, my sense is awakened. I shall from this day kill with the might of my own arms the beasts of the forest and feast on their flesh. Having said this he went away into the forest. At this time the mouse came there. Seeing him come, the Jackal thus spoke to him.

sa: स राममासाद्य तदा त्रिजटो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। निर्धनो बहुपुत्रोऽस्मि राजपुत्र महाबल॥ क्षतवृत्तिवने नित्यं प्रत्यवेक्षस्व मामिति।
en: O mighty son of the King! a poor man am I, having a number of children. I maintain my family by digging the earth; do you therefore look upon me mercifully.

sa: ममाप्येवं विशालाक्षी जानकी जातसम्भ्रमा। मदनेनाभिवर्तेत यदि नापहता भवेत्॥
en: Sītā of expansive eyes would have thus neared me being influenced by amour had she not been carried away.

sa: ततस्ते रथघोषेण स्थनेमिस्वनेन च। पूरयन्तो दिशः सर्वा धनंजयमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: The Trigarta warriors, however filling the ten points with the sound of their cars and carwheels, rushed towards Dhananjaya.

sa: देवानां वह हव्यं त्वमहं वीर सुदुर्बलः। अथ त्वं गच्छ मध्वक्षं प्रियमेतत् कुरुष्व मे॥
en: "O hero, carry the oblations for the celestials. I am unable to do it for the want of strength. Becoming the red-eyed fire, be good enough to do me this favour."

sa: याजयामास तं कण्वो विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणम्। श्रीमान् गोविततं नाम वाजिमेधमवाप सः। यस्मिन् सहस्रं पद्मानां कण्वाय भरतो ददौ॥
en: Kanva was the chief priest in those sacrifices and great offerings were made to the Brahmanas. The fortunate king performed both the cow and the horse-sacrifices. Bharata gave one thousand gold coins to Kanva as his sacrificial fee.

sa: अग्नीनामतिथीनां च शुश्रूषुरनसूयिका। समाराधयत क्षिप्रं च्यवनं सा शुभानना॥
en: The beautiful-featured one, that guileless lady, worshipped Chyavana and waited upon his guests and ministers to the sacred fire.

sa: कर्णश्च दशभिर्बाणैः पुत्रश्च तव सप्तभिः। दशभिर्वृषसेनश्च सौबलश्चापि सप्तभिः॥
en: Karna pierced him with ten shafts, your son with seven, Vrishasena with ten and Subala's son with seven arrows.

sa: पितामहं रणे हत्वा मन्यसे धर्ममात्मनः। मया शत्रौ हते कस्मात् पापे धर्मं न मन्यसे॥
en: When you slew your aged grandsire, you thought it your duty to do so. But when I have slain my wicked foe, why should it not be regarded as my duty?

sa: शार्दूलस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शार्दूलजननी ततः॥ मृगराजं हितैर्वाक्यैः सम्बोधयितुमागमत्।
en: Hearing these words of the tiger, his mother came there for awakening her son's good sense with wholesome advice.

sa: हर्षश्चाभ्यधिको राजञ्जनस्य पुरवासिनः। काले वर्षति पर्जन्यः पातयन्नमृतं पयः॥
en: The delight of the citizens has been greatly increased, Oking. Indra has been pouring nectar-like showers in due time.

sa: भूतानां तु विपर्यासं कुरुते भगवानिति। न ह्येतावद् भवेद् गम्यं न यस्मात् प्रभवेत् पुनः॥
en: Through the force of Ignorance, Brahma makes the attribute of materiality to invest the Chit or Soul which is immaterial spirit. Materiality, however, is not the true attribute of the Soul.

sa: तस्य तच्छतधा रूपमभवच्च सहस्रधा। तानि चास्य शरीराणि शरैरहमताडयम्॥
en: Thereupon his body became multiplied a hundred and a thousand times. (But) I pierced all his bodies with arrows.

sa: अभिप्रायमथो ज्ञात्वा महेन्द्रस्य विभावसुः। कुण्डलार्थे महाराज सूर्यः कर्णमुपागतः॥
en: But Vibhavasu (the sun) aware of the intentions of Mahendra about the ear-rings, O mighty Monarch, appeared before Karna.

sa: पादपात् पादपं गच्छशैलाच्छैलं वनाद् वनम्॥ वाति नैकरसास्वादसम्मोदित इवानिलः।
en: The breeze, delighted with various tastes is passing from tree to tree, mountain to mountains and forest to forest.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रायशो राजलोकस्ते कथितो वदतां वर। वैवस्वतसभायां तु यथा वदसि मे प्रभो॥
en: Yudhishthira said O best of eloquent men, O lord, from your descriptions it appears that all the monarchs (of the earth) are in the Sabha of the son of Vaivasvata (Yama).

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु मैथिली सीतामाश्रमे संप्रवेशिताम्। संतापमगमद्धोरं लक्ष्मणो दीनचेतनः॥
en: Beholding the great ascetic Vālmīki thus conducting Sītā into his own hermitage Lakş mana's heart was bewildered with grief.

sa: तं तु शब्दमभिश्रुत्य भीमसेनो महाबलः। भभूव परमप्रीतः पार्थदर्शनलालसः॥
en: The mighty Bhimasena, anxious as he was to have a look of Partha, became highly gratified with that sound.

sa: तमेवमभिभाषन्तमाकाश इव निर्मलः। भरतः श्लक्ष्णया वाचा गुहं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: When Guha had asked this, Bharata with a presence unclouded like the sky, spoke to Guha these sweet words.

sa: अनास्तिक्यं च सर्वेषामस्माकमपि रक्षणे। प्रतितिष्ठेत लोकेऽस्मिन्नधर्मश्चैव नो भवेत्॥
en: Our own irreligiousness will also be talked all over the kingdom and we shall certainly incur a great sin.

sa: श्रुत्वैव च महाबाहुर्मा भैरित्याह तं द्विजम्। आयुधानि च यत्रावसन् पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥ कृष्णया सह तत्रास्ते धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। सम्प्रवेशाय चाशक्तो गमनाय च पाण्डवः॥
en: As soon as he heard it, the mighty-armed hero told the Brahmana, "Don't fear". But in the room where the arms of the illustrious Pandavas were, Dharmaraja Yudhishthira was then sitting with Krishna (Draupadi). The Pandavas (Arjuna) was, therefore, unable to enter the room or to go (with the Brahmana).

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु भरतो निषादाधिपतिं गुहम्। प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो वाक्यं हेत्वर्थसंहितम्॥
en: Thus addressed, the exceedingly wise Bharata answered the lord of the Nişādas, in words fraught with sense and reason.

sa: अश्विनाविव देवानां याविमौ रूपसम्पदा। तौ प्राकृतवदद्यमौ प्रसुप्तौ धरणीतले॥
en: The twins, who are handsome as the Asvinis among the celestial, are asleep on the ground like ordinary men!

sa: हतयोधस्ततो राजन् क्षीणकोशश्च भूमिपः। दिवोदासः पुरीं त्यक्त्वा पलायनपरोऽभवत्॥
en: King Divodasa, O king, having lost his army and seeing his treasury exhausted left his capital and fled away.

sa: स दीर्घबाहुः संक्रुद्धस्तोत्रादित इव द्विपः। अष्टभिः कृतवर्माणमविद्ध्यत् परमेषुभिः॥
en: Enraged at this like an elephant struck with a lance, the long-armed Satyaki struck Kritavarman with eight best arrows.

sa: ततः शरसहस्राणि क्षिप्रहस्तो निशाचरः। निजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो राघवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Then the fleet-handed night-ranger, fired with rage, discharged a thousand arrows at the chest of the high souled Raghava.

sa: वानराणां हि धीराणां सहस्त्रैः परिवारितः। रामोऽभ्येति पुरीं लङ्कामस्माकमुपरोधकः॥
en: Environed by a thousand of patient monkeys, Rāma, with a view to capture our city, is approaching towards Lankā.

sa: भीममुग्रं महात्मानं त्र्यक्षं शर्व कपर्दिनम्॥ न शक्ता द्रष्टमीशानं किं पुनर्योधित प्रभुम्। त्वया साक्षान्महादेव सर्वभूतशिवः शिवः॥ युद्धेनाराधितः स्थाणुर्देवाश्च वरदास्तव। तस्य पार्थ प्रसादेन देवदवस्य शूलिनः॥ जहि कर्णं महाबाहो नमुचिं वृत्रहा यथा। श्रेयस्तेऽस्तु सदा पार्थ युद्धे जयमवाप्नुहि॥
en: Nothing need be told about fighting; men cannot look towards the great god the three eyed and terrible Sarva, also called the Kaparddin. You have satisfied in battle that god of gods the Siva, deity Sthanu, the creator of the happiness of all creatures. O Partha, as Indra slew Namuchi so you will, O, you of powerful arms, by the kindness of the great god who is armed with trident, kill Karna and be victorious; and may it farewell with you.

sa: रथिनां रथिभिः सार्धं रुधिरस्त्रावदारुणम्। प्रावर्तत महद् युद्धं निघ्नताभितरेतरम्॥
en: Car-warriors were engaged in terrible battle, cause a dreadful flow of blood against (rival) car-warriors and smote one another.

sa: प्रतिविन्ध्यं तु समरे कुवार्णं कर्म दुष्करम्। दुःशासनसिभिर्बाणैर्ललाटे समविध्यत॥
en: In (that) battle, Prativindhya, who was achieving frightful feats, was pierced by Dushasana in the forehead with three arrows.

sa: चेदयश्च महेष्वासा द्रोणमेवाभ्ययुर्युधि। तेषां दुपदपौत्राणां त्रयाणां निशितैः शरैः॥
en: And the Chedis, all fierce bowmen, assailed Drona in battle. Of those three grandsons of Drupada, with sharp arrows.

sa: दुपदं तु सहानीकं द्रोणप्रेप्सुं महारथम्। वृषसेनोऽभ्ययात् तूर्णं किरशरशतैस्तदा॥
en: Then, O great king, Vrishasena, covered that great car-warrior Drupada, who, followed by his army, was advancing against Drona.

sa: त्वया कथितमत्यर्थं कर्णेन सह हृष्टवत्॥ असकृच्छून्यवन्मोहाद् धृतराष्ट्रस्य शृण्वतः।
en: Accompanied by Karna and delightful you used to brag always, out of your foolishness, within Dhritarashtra's hearing, with these

sa: जातमात्रेण वीरेण येनोच्चैःश्रवसा यथा॥ द्वेषता कम्पिता भूमिर्लोकाश्च सकलास्रयः।
en: As soon as he was born that hero ncighed like Uchhaisravas and thereby caused the three words to tremble.

sa: मा त्वं ब्रह्मगति हिंस्याः प्रायश्चित्तं कृतं त्वया। मद्वाक्यं नानृतं लोके कश्चित् कुर्यात् समानुहि॥
en: You shall not destroy the means of Brahmana's livelihood. There is none on earth who can falsify my words. Accept my words and this will be an atonement for your sin,

sa: तद् बलं नृपतिश्रेष्ठ तावकं विजयो रणे। व्यक्षोभयदुदीर्णाश्वं महोदधिमिवानिलः॥
en: As the wind agitates a great ocean so Vijaya overpowered your army, O foremost of kings, abounding in horse-men.

sa: मत्ता वेगवतो राजस्तावकानां रणाङ्गणे॥ हस्तिनश्च हतारोहा दारिताङ्गा सहस्रशः।
en: Thousands of mad elephants possessed of great energy, O king, of your army, their riders slain the limbs mangled.

sa: अन्तर्धाय महाशब्दान् कर्णेनमिततेजसा॥ दोधूयमानस्य भृशं धनुषः शृणु निःस्वनम्।
en: Karna, of unfathomable prowess, has drawn his bow and its loud twang can be heard above all other sounds.

sa: न्यवेदयन् भयं घोरं सज्वालकवलैर्मुखैः। उलूकाश्चाप्यदृश्यन्त शंसन्तो विपुलं भयम्॥ विशेषतः कौरवाणां ध्वजिन्यामतिदारुणाः। ततः सैन्येषु राजेन्द्र शब्दः समभवन्महान्॥
en: And with their gaping mouths all ablaze indicated dreadful terror. Specially greatly terrible owls, screaming from the standards of the Kauravas, foreboded dreadful terror. Then, O king of kings, there arose a tumultuous uproar from among the troops.

sa: पतितैश्चामरैश्चैव श्वेतच्छत्रैश्च भारत। बभूव धरणी पूर्णा नक्षत्रै?रिव प्रभो॥
en: The earth then over-strewn with shattered yak-tails and white umbrellas, looked, O king, as beautiful as the star-bespangled firmament,

sa: यथा हि शकुनि गृह्य छित्वा पक्षौ च संजय॥ विसर्जयन्ति संहृष्टाः क्रीडमानाः कुमारकाः। लूनपक्षतया तस्य गमनं नोपपद्यते॥ तथाऽमहपि सम्प्राप्तो लूनपक्ष इव द्विजः।
en: O Sanjaya, even as the playful boys having caught a bird and torn off its wings most cheerfully let it go. And whose (the bird's) flight does not become possible in consequence of the loss of its wings; so I have become (motionless) like the bird deprived of its wings.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरः सहदेवो जनाधिप। अपोवाह रथेनाजौ पार्षतं शत्रुतापनम्॥
en: In the interval O king, the heroic Sahadeva carried away on his chariot Parshata the scorcher of his enemies.

sa: ते क्षत्रियाः कुण्डलिनो युवानः परस्परं सायकविक्षताङ्गाः। कुम्भेषु लीना: सुषुपुर्गजानां कुचेषु लग्ना इव कामिनीनाम्॥
en: Then those Kshatriyas all youthful and graced with earnings, mangled with one another's shaft-wounds, lying down on the back of clephants slept as if lying on the breasts of beautiful ladies.

sa: सिंहनादरवांश्चक्रुः पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः॥ पश्यतस्तव पुत्रस्य कर्णस्य च रणोत्कटाः। तथा द्रोणस्य शूरस्य द्रौणेश्चैव विशाम्पते॥
en: The Pandavas ever attended with victory uttered dreadful war-cries, even before the eyes of your son and Karna and the heroic Drona and the son of Drona, O ruler of men.

sa: शस्त्रैघवर्षं रुधिराम्बुधारं निशि प्रवृत्तं रणदुर्दिनं तत्। तस्मिन् महाग्निप्रतिमो महात्मा संतापयन् पाण्डवान् विप्रमुख्यः॥ गभस्तिभिर्मध्यगमो यथार्को वर्षात्यये तद्वदभून्नरेन्द्र॥
en: In that encounter that foremost of the Brahmanas, he magnanimous (Drona) endued with the energy of a great fire began to afflict the Pandavas like the noon day sun, (scorching everything) at the end of the rainy season.

sa: अमर्षिता महाशङ्खान् दध्मुर्वीरा महारथाः। कृते प्रतिकरिष्यन्तः केशवस्यार्जुनस्य च॥
en: Blew their huge conchs, desirous of answering with the blasts thus produced, the blasts produced by Keshava and Arjuna.

sa: तस्य तुष्टो महादेवो वराणां वरदः प्रभुः। वरेण च्छन्दयामास स तु वने वरं नृपः॥
en: That foremost of all boon-giving deities namely Mahadeva became pleased with him and requested him to ask for his desired boon. The royal son of Somadatta then asked for this boon-

sa: तामस्य विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षिप्यमाणां महारथः। निजधान शरैर्दोणः क्रुद्धः सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Then that truly valiant and mighty carwarrior the enraged Drona, destroyed with his sharp that mace hurled by Dhristadyumna.

sa: अलम्बुषं राक्षसेन्द्रं कुन्तिभोजो महारथः। सैन्येन महता युक्तः क्रुद्धरूपमवारयत्॥
en: The mighty car-warrior Kuntibhoja, supported by large division of troops resisted that wrathful Alambusha that best of the Rakshasas.

sa: तिरस्कृता चाद्य यथा न साधु। भीतो भीमं त्यज्य चायास्तथा त्वं यन्नाशकः कर्णमथो निहन्तुम्॥
en: “Your army, my brother, must have been disgraced today and fled away, stricken with fear. And you have come here forsaking Bhima because you have not been able to kill Karna.

sa: तौ हि वीरौ महेष्वासौ मदर्थे त्यक्तजीवितौ। भीष्मद्रोणौ हतौ श्रुत्वा को न्वर्थो जीवितेन मे॥
en: Indeed, those two heroes, the great bowmen, were ready to give up their lives for my sake. Hearing of their (Bhishma and Drona) death, what use have I of my life?

sa: श्रीवासुदेव उवाच घटोत्कच विजानीहि यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि पुत्रक। प्राप्तो विक्रमकालोऽयं तव नान्यस्य कस्यचित्॥
en: Vasudeva said Take my blessings, O Ghatotkacha, hear attentively what I now say to you. The hour for the display of your prowess and of no one else has now arrived.

sa: चतुर्भिः सिन्धुराजश्च वृषसेनश्च सप्तभिः। पृथक् पृथङ्महाराज विव्यधुः कृष्णपाण्डवौ॥
en: The king of the Sindhus with four. Vrishasena with Karna, separately pierced 0 mighty monarch, Krishna and Pritha's son.

sa: किरन्तः शरवर्षाणि महान्ति दृढधन्विनः। न शक्रुवन्त्यवस्थातुं पीड्यमानाः शरार्चिषा॥
en: Scorched with his fiery arrows the Pandava warrior cannot stand before that resolute bowman who is shooting numerous arrows.

sa: उक्तोऽसि बहुधा राजन् मा युध्यस्वेति पाण्डवैः। गृह्णीषे न च तन्मोहाद् वचनं च विशाम्पते॥
en: O monarch, it was several times told to you, that you should not fight with the, Pandavas. But, O ruler of earth, that advice you did not accept out of foolishness.

sa: एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच विजयो भरतर्षभ। सत्येन ते शपे राजन् प्रसादेन तथैव च। भीमेन च नरश्रेष्ठ यमाभ्यां च महीपते॥ यथाद्य समरे कर्णं हनिष्यामि हतोऽपि वा। महीतले पतिष्यामि सत्येनायुधमालभे॥
en: O mighty scion of the Bharata race, upon hearing Yudhishthira thus express himself, Vijaya replied-"O foremost of kings, O lord of the earth, solemnly do I swear unto you that by your grace, by Bhima and the twins that this day either I shall slay Karna or myself kiss the earth being slain by him. I take this vow upon this weapon."

sa: रथानां द्रवते वृन्दमेतचैव समन्ततः। द्राव्यमाणं रणे पार्थ कर्णेनमित्रकर्षिणा॥
en: Pursued in battle by Karna, the grinder of his enemies the collection of cars is dispersed on all sides.

sa: अर्थोक्ताः कुरुपञ्चालाः शाल्वाः कृत्स्नानुशासनाः। पर्वतीयाच विषमा यथैव शिवयस्तथा॥
en: The mountaineers like Sivis are very dull. The Yavanas are omniscient, O king and the Suras and particularly so.

sa: शरसम्भिन्नगात्रौ तु सर्वतः शकलीकृतौ। श्वाविधाविव राजेन्द्र दृश्यतां शरविक्षतौ॥
en: With their bodies pierced, mangled and wounded with shafts, they looked, O king of kings, like two hedge hogs.

sa: अलम्बुषं तथा शूरा विशीर्णमिव पर्वतम्। हाहाकारमकार्षुश्च सैन्यानि भरतर्षभ॥
en: And crushed like a mountain, your heroic warriors, O foremost of the Bharatas, uttered exclamations of Alas and Oh.

sa: वादिवाण्यभ्यवाद्यन्त शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ तस्मिंस्तु तुमुले युद्धे भीरूणां भयवर्धने।
en: And sounded hundreds and thousands of musical instruments. And in that terrific battle enhancing the terror of the coward.

sa: संरब्धौ क्रोधताम्राक्षौ प्रेक्ष्य कर्णवृकोदरौ। संत्रस्ताः समकम्पन्त त्वदीयानां महारथाः॥
en: Beholding Karna and Vrikodara burning with rage with, their eyes coppery therewith, your mighty car-warriors began tremble with fear.

sa: सिद्धचारणसंघाश्च सम्पेतुस्ते समन्ततः। चिन्तयन्तो भवेदद्य लोकानां स्वस्तयपीति च॥
en: There hordes of Siddhas and Charanas poured in form every direction all solicitous of common weal for the day.

sa: ईदृशा ब्राह्मणेनोक्ता वाहीका मोघचारिणः॥ येषां षड्भागहर्ता त्वमुभयोः शुभपापयोः।
en: Thus did the Brahmanas describe the vile Balhikas, a sixty of whose merit and demerit, you possess, O Shalya.

sa: ततः शरशतैस्तीक्षणैरश्वत्थामा प्रतापवान्। निश्चैष्टौ तावुभौ युद्धे चक्रे माघवपाण्डवौ॥
en: And thus the violent Ashvatthama, with hundreds of keen arrows, put both Madhava and Pandu's son into utter confusion.

sa: अथापरान् महाराज सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ जघान् बहुसाहस्रान् योधान् युद्धविशारदान्।
en: Thereupon, O king, the powerful son of charioteer killed thousands of other heroes-all skillful in the manoeuvre of war.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच भीम नारायणस्त्रे मे गोषु च ब्राह्मणेषु च। एतेषु गाण्डिवं न्यस्यमेतद्धि व्रतमुत्तमम्॥
en: Arjuna said O Bhima, my great vow is that I shall not use the Gandiva-bow against Brahmanas the kine and the Narayana weapon and against these I shall lay it aside.

sa: अथ द्रोणं समारोहचेकितानो महाबलः। स द्रोणंदशभिर्विद्धवा प्रत्यविद्धयत् स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Thereafter the mighty Chekitana-countered Drona and piercing the latter with ten arrows, once more wounded him on the breast.

sa: पृष्ठतः सत्यसंधस्य जिष्णोर्भरतसत्तम। तौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ यत्तौ द्रोणानीकमभिद्रुतौ॥
en: Behind Jishnu of unerring aim, O foremost of the Bharatas. Seeing those two brothers resolutely rush towards Drona's division.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच प्रोक्तस्त्वया पूर्वमेव प्रवीरो लोकविश्रुतः। न त्वस्य कर्म संग्रामे त्वया संजय कीर्तितम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said The name of that foremost of heroes celebrated all over the world, was related by you already; but O Sanjaya, his achievements in battle were not related by you.

sa: तस्य तस्यान्तगा बाणाः शरीरे न्यपतन् प्रभो॥ कबन्धसंकुलं चक्रे तव सैन्यं महारथः। अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठः शरैरग्न्यंशुसंनिभैः॥ एवं तत् तव राजेन्द्र चतुरङ्गबलं तदा। व्याकुलीकृत्य कौन्तेयो जयद्रथमुपाद्रवत्॥ द्रौणिं पञ्चाशताविध्यद् वृषसेनं त्रिभिः शरैः।
en: Had his body pierced deep with the latter's arrows. Then the mighty car-warriors Arjuna, that foremost of victorious heroes made your ranks headless by means of his arrows resembling the flames of fire. Thus then, O foremost of kings, sorely afflicting your troops consisting of four kinds of forces, the son of Kunti rushed upon Jayadratha. He then pierced Drona's son with five hundred and Vrishasena with three arrows.

sa: तत्राह कर्ण च सुयोधनं च कृपं द्रौणिं कृतवर्माणमेव॥ निहन्मि दुःशासनमद्य पापं संरक्ष्यतामद्य समस्तयोधाः।
en: Addressing the great warriors, Karna, Suyodhana, Drona's son Kripa and Kritavarman, he said-"I will thus day put an end to the life of this miscreant Dushasana, defend him if you can."

sa: स तद् विकृष्य भगवान् दिव्यं लोकेश्वरो धनुः॥ ११२ त्रैलोक्यसारं तमिषु मुमोच त्रिपुरं प्रति।
en: Then that illustrious lord of the three worlds, after having stretched that celestial bow, shot that arrow, which was made of the essence of the three worlds, at the triple city.

sa: ततः कुञ्जरयूथानि समेतानि सहस्रशः॥ व्यधमत् तरसा भीमो मेघसङ्घानिवानिलः।
en: As the wind scatters a collection of clouds so Bhima dispersed and killed those elephants collected there in thousands.

sa: कर्णश्च समरे राजन् व्यद्रावयत् पार्थिवान्। धृष्टद्युम्निशिखण्ड्यादीन् पञ्चालानां महारथान्॥
en: Similarly, O king, Karna caused many kings of fly away-including Dhristadyumna, Shikhandin and other mighty car-warriors of the Panchalas.

sa: यान् स्म तान् ग्लहते तात शकुनिः कुरुसंसदि। अक्षान् न तेऽरक्षा निशिता बाणास्ते शत्रुतापनाः॥
en: The dice with which Shakuni played in the assembly-hall of the Kurus, O affecnate one, are not (real) dice but their arrows destructive of foes, has ever been able to achieve.

sa: तथा शान्तनवं वृद्धं ब्रह्मन् बाह्रीकमेव च। द्रोण च सोमदत्तं च भूरिश्रवसमेव च॥ तथैव चान्यान् सुहृदः पुत्रान् पौत्रांच पातितान्। श्रुत्वा यन्नाजहात् प्राणां स्तन्मन्ये दुष्करं द्विज॥
en: As, O twice-born one, having heard of the fall of the old son of Shantanu, of Balhika, of Drona, of Somadatta, of Bhurisravas, as well as of other friends, of his sons and grandsons, the king did not give up his life; so, I suppose, that to yield up one's life is, O regenerate person, highly difficult.

sa: घटोत्कच उवाच तिष्ठ तिष्ठ न मे जीवन् द्रोणपुत्र गमिष्यसि॥ त्वामद्य निहनिष्यामि क्रौञ्चमग्निसुतो यथा।
en: Ghatotkacha said O son of Drona, 'wait, wait.' You will not escape alive from me. I will today destroy you as the son of Angi (i.e. Kartikeya) rived the (mountain) Krouncha.

sa: कर्णोऽपि समरे राजन् धर्मपुत्रमरिंदमम्। स शैरश्छादयामास सारथिं चाप्यपातयत्॥
en: Karna too, O king, coveredwith arrows in battle Dharma's son, the subduer of foes and struck down his charioteer.

sa: हतं दृष्ट्वा महाकायं वकज्ञातिमरिंदमम्। पञ्चालाः पाण्डवाश्चैव सिंहनादान् विनेदिरे॥
en: Beholding the huge-bodied brother of Vaka, that subduer of foes, slain, the Panchalas and the Pandavas uttered tremendous warcries.

sa: तौ रथौ सीर्यसंकशौ वैयाघ्रपरिवारितौ। समेतो दद्दशुस्तत्र द्वाविरामै समुद्गतौ॥
en: Then those two cars covered with tiger skins and shinning with lustre looked like two suns facing each other.

sa: नाशक्नुवन् वारयितुं वर्धमानमिवानलम्। अथ दुर्योधनः कर्णः शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥
en: Could not check him even as men cannot check the raging conflagration. Thereupon Duryodhana, Karna and Subala's son Sakuni.

sa: व्यथमद् द्रोणतनयो नीलमेघं समुत्थितम्॥ स मार्गणगणैौणिर्दिशः प्रच्छाद्य सर्वशः।
en: The son Drona destroyed that rising blue cloud covering all points completely with numerous arrows, the son of Drona.

sa: शङ्खशब्दं च कुर्वाणौ युयुधाते परस्परम्। तस्य भीमः पुनश्चापं मुष्टौ चिच्छेद मारिष॥ इव क्रोधाद्
en: Oking, then once more Bhima cut-off the bow of Karna near the grasp and with his arrows dispatched the latter's steeds of the hue of conch to the regions of Death.

sa: मम सर्वेऽपि राजानो जानन्त्येव महाव्रतम्। न शक्यो मामको हन्तुं यो मे स्याद् बाणगोचरे॥
en: All kings know of this my great vow, that no one shall slay any body of our party so long as the latter is with in the range of my arrows.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य भीमस्यामितविक्रमः। ततोऽर्जुनोऽब्रवीत् कर्णं किंचिदभ्येत्य संयुगे॥
en: Thus addressed by Bhima, Arjuna of matchless prowess, coming up to Karna in that battle, said to him (thus):

sa: युयुधानमनन्विषय लोको मां गर्हयिष्यति। भ्रातुरन्वेषणं कृत्वा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Not taking any care for Yuyudhana, the world will blame any say-"King Yudhishthira the virtuous enquiring after his brother.

sa: रुधिरेणावसिक्ताङ्गा गैरिकप्रस्त्रवा इव। यथा भ्राजन्ति स्यन्दन्तः पर्वता धातुमण्डिताः॥
en: Bathed in blood those huge creatures looked resplendent like moving hills covered with metals and streams of liquid chalk.

sa: स मा समासाद्य नरेन्द्र यत्त: समभ्ययात् सिंहमिव द्विपेन्द्रः। अकार्षीच रथिनामुजिहीर्षां महाराज वध्यता कौरवाणाम्॥
en: Encountering me, O king, the hero rushed resolutely against me like a leader of elephants rushing upon a lion and intended to rescue the warriors who were being slain by me.

sa: बहुधा पार्षतेन महात्मना। न विव्यथे ततो द्रोण: स्मयन्नेवान्वयुध्यत॥
en: Though covered on all sides by the illustrious son of Prisata, yet Drona flinched not, but fought on smilingly.

sa: तथा द्रौणिर्महाराज शरान् हेमविभूषितान्। तैलधौतान् प्रसन्नाग्रान् प्राहिणोद् वधकासया॥
en: Thereafter Drona's son, O king, shot at Bhima, desirous or slaying him, arrows of keen points, washed with oil.

sa: सोऽपसृत्य दुतं सूतो युधामन्यो रथं ययौ। विहसन्निव भीमस्य क्रुद्धः कालानलद्युतिः॥ ध्वज चिच्छेद राधेयः पताकां च व्यपातयत्। स विधन्वा महाबाहुरथ शक्तिं परामृशत्॥
en: Thereupon the charioteer running in haste, ascended the car of Yudhamyu. Burning with Wrath, Radha's son, whose effulgence then equaled the effulgence of the Yuga-fire, cut-off the standard of Bhima and felled his banner, smiling the while. Deprived of the use of his bow, Bhima then grasped a fearful lance.

sa: ततः शरसहस्राणि प्रादुरासन् विशाम्पते॥ ध्वजानां छिद्यमानानां कार्मुकाणां च मारिष। रथानां सपताकानां तूणीराणां युगैः सह।॥ अक्षाणामथ चक्राणां योक्त्राणां रश्मिभिः सह। कूबराणां वरूथाणां पृषत्कानां च संयुगे॥ अश्वानां पततां चापि प्रासनामृष्टिभिः सह। गदानां परिधाना च शक्तितोमरपट्टिशैः॥ शतघ्नींनां सचक्राणां भुजानां चोरुभिः सह। कण्ठसूत्रामदानां च केयूराणां च मारिष॥ हाराणामथ निष्काणां तनुत्राणां च भारत। छत्राणां व्यजनानां च शिरसां मुकुटैः सह॥ अश्रूयत महाशब्दस्तत्र तत्र विशम्पते।
en: Thereupon, O ruler of earth, thousands of arrows continuously issued forth therefore. O sire, of broken standards and bows, of cars along with their banners, of quivers and yokes. Also of axles and wheels, of traces along with the chords, of bottoms of cars, of wooden fences about the cars and innumerable shafts in the field of battle. And of falling horses and of spears along with the swords, of maces and spiked clubs, of Sakti-arrows, lances and axes. And of Shataghnis furnished with wheels, as well as of the arms along with the thighs, of wreaths and Angadas, of Keyuras and of garlands and cuirasses, of of armours, of umbrellas and fans, of heads adorned with coronets, of these a tremendous roar, O ruler of carth, was heard in all the directions of the field of battle.

sa: यत्र भीष्मो महाबाहुः शेते शरशताचितः॥ विकर्णश्चित्रसेनश्च बाह्रीकोऽथ जयद्रथः।
en: Since the mighty-armed Bhisma lies (on the field) struck by a hundred arrows, (and since) Vikarna, Chitrasena, Valhika, Jayadratha.

sa: ध्यात्तानना घोरजिह्वाः क्रोधतानेक्षणा भृशम्। सिंहनादेन महता नादयन्तो वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Having gaping mouths, long tongues and eyes burning in ire, causing the earth to tremble with great leonine roars.

sa: ते विंशतिपदे यत्ता गुरुपुत्रममर्षणम्। पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिर्बाणैरभ्यजन् सर्वतः समम्॥
en: Advancing twenty paces, each of these warriors shot with great care, five arrows at the revengeful son of Drona.

sa: स तोत्रैरिव मातङ्गो वार्यमाणः पतत्रिभिः। अभ्यधावदसम्भ्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं वृकोदरः॥
en: Assailed with those winged shaft, like an elephant assailed with the hook, Vrikodara then dauntlessly rushed against Suta's son.

sa: भूरिश्रवाः कृपो द्रौणिर्मद्रराजो जयद्रथः। उत्तमौजा युधामन्युः सात्यकिः केशवार्जुनौ॥
en: Then Bhurisravas, Kripa, the son of Drona, the ruler of the Madras, Jayadratha, Uttamoujas, Yudhamanyu, Satyaki, Keshava and Arjuna.

sa: सात्यकिं तु महाराज प्रहसन्निव भारत॥ दुःशासनस्त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः।
en: But O Bharata, Dushasana, smiling a little, pierced Satyaki O king, first with three and then with five shafts,

sa: दासभार्या च पाञ्चालि स्वयं दासी च शोभने। अद्य दुर्योधनो ह्येकः पृथिव्यां नृपतिः स्मृतः॥
en: O Princess of Panchala, you are now the wife of men that are servants and O beautiful one, yourself, a maid. Duryodhana alone is regarded as the ruler of this earth.

sa: स तद् रूपं भैरवं भीमकर्मा भीमं कृत्वा भैमसेनिः पपात। हतोऽप्येवं तव सैन्येकदेश मपोथयत् स्वेन देहेन राजन्॥
en: Having assumed that terrible and dreadful figure, Bhimasena's son of frightful deeds fell down. When dying, O monarch, he fell upon a portion of your army and pressed those troops down by the weight of his own body.

sa: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो वाहिनीपतिः। व्यादिदेश महावीर्यो वानरान्वानरर्षभः॥
en: Hearing Rāghava's words, that foremost of monkeys and lord of the army, the exceedingly energetic Sugrīva, issued his orders.

sa: ततस्तु सा लक्ष्मणरामपालिता महाचमूहष्टजना यशस्विनी। श्रिया ज्वलन्ती विरराज सर्वतो निशा प्रणीतेव हि शीतरश्मिना॥
en: Thereupon that famous and well-pleased huge army of the monkeys protected by Råma and Lakşmaņa, appeared resplendent on all sides like to a night beautified with the rays of the Moon.

sa: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवो मेघाश्च खरनिःस्वनाः। प्रभभौ न च सूर्यो वै महोल्काश्चापतन्भुवि॥ चकम्पे जगती चैव ववुर्वाताः सुदारुणाः। अक्षोभ्यः क्षुभितश्चैव समुद्रः सरितां पतिः॥
en: That god showered down blood; and the clouds uttered forth harsh sounds. And the sun was deprived of his splendour; and meteors began to dart to the earth. And the earth shook; and the wind swept away violently. And that lord of streams-the ocean, which was calm before, became agitated.

sa: ते चास्य हयमुख्येषु तूर्णमुत्पत्य वानराः। चतुर्षु सुमहावीर्या निपेतुर्भीमविक्रमाः॥
en: And suddenly springing up, those highly powerful monkeys endowed with terrific prowess descended upon those four best of steeds.

sa: एवं निर्भय॑माना सा सीता सुरसुतोपमा। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिधैर्यमुत्सृज्य रोदिति ॥
en: Being thus threatened by those grim-visaged Rākṣasīs Sītā, resembling the daughter of a celestial, renouncing patience, began to weep.

sa: पुत्रद्वयं ममाप्यस्यां भार्यायां संबभूव ह॥ मायावी प्रथमस्तात दुन्दुभिस्तदनन्तरः।
en: On this wife of mine I have also beget two sons. The first is Māyāvī and the next Dundubhi.

sa: संवर्तो नाम ब्रह्मर्षिः साक्षाद्धाता बृहस्पतेः। याजयामास धर्मज्ञः सर्वैर्देवगणैर्वृतः॥
en: And a righteous Brahmarşi named Samvarta, the very brother of Bphaspati, officiated at the sacrifice accompanied by the deities.

sa: नर्मदापुलिने हृद्ये शुभ्राभ्रसदृशप्रभे॥ राक्षसैस्तु मुहुर्तेन कृतः पुष्पमयो गिरिः।
en: In a moment the Rākṣasas collected heaps of flowers on the picturesque banks of Narmadā, resembling the white clouds.

sa: यं तु पश्यसि तिष्ठन्तं प्रभिन्नमिव कुञ्जरम्। यो बलात्क्षोभयेत्क्रुद्धः समुद्रमपि वानरः॥ एषोऽभिगन्ता लङ्कायां वैदेह्यास्तव च प्रभो। एनं पश्य पुरा दृष्टं वानरं पुनरागतम्।९।। ज्येष्ठः केसरिणः पुत्रो वातात्मज इति श्रुतः। हनूमानिति विख्यातो लङ्घितो येन सागरः॥
en: He whom you seseestaying like a mad elephant, the monkey who, being enraged, can by his strength agitate the deep itself, who, searching for Vaidehi, had presented himself before you, lord, behold this monkey come again!-whom you had seen before!*—is the eldest son of Kacari, known as the offspring of the Wind-god-celebrated as Hanumān, who had bounded over the deep. *This dislocation occurs in the original. These descriptions generally are hardly amenable to a sound syntax.

sa: दुद्रुवुर्बहुधा भीता राक्षसाः शतशो दिशः। त्यक्त्वा प्रहरणान्सर्वे पट्टिशासिपरश्वधान्॥
en: And overwhelmed with fright, Rākṣasas fled in an hundred directions, all renouncing their arms-bearded darts, and swords, and axes.

sa: ततः प्रहर्षाद्भरतमङ्कमारोप्य राघवः। ययौ तेन विमानेन ससैन्यो भरताश्रमम्॥
en: Thereupon placing Bharata, in delight, on his lap, Raghava, with his army in that car, proceeded towards Bharata's abode.

sa: राक्षसानां सहस्रेस्तु बहुभिः शस्त्रपाणिभिः॥ युक्तः परमसंविग्नो राक्षसैः सह मन्त्रवित्। उत्तरं नगरद्वारं रावणः स्वयमास्थितः॥
en: And, backed by many thousands of Räkşasas wielding weapons, and accompanied by Rākşasas conversant with counsel, Rāvana himself, his heart agitated to the height, gaurd the Northern gate of the city.

sa: ते रावणशरा घोरा राघवास्त्रसमाहताः।४८।। विलयं जग्मुराकाशे जघ्नुश्चैव सहस्रशः।
en: Those terrific shafts of Răvana, resisted by Rāghava's weapon, were annihilated in the sky, and destroyed (monkeys) by thousands.

sa: सर्वे ते वानरश्रेष्ठाः ससुग्रीवमहाबलाः। परिवार्य महात्मानौ तस्थुः शोकपरिप्लुताः॥
en: All those foremost monkeys, along with Sugrīva, possessed of exceeding strength, overwhelmed with sorrow, remained surrounding those high-souled ones.

sa: अष्टादशशरैस्तीक्ष्णैः स विद्ध्वा गन्धमादनम्। विव्याध नवभिश्चैव नलं दूरादवस्थितम्।॥
en: And piercing Gandhamādana with eight and ten sharp arrows, he wounded Nila stationed at a distance with nine shafts.

sa: अकम्पनस्तु शैलाभं हनूमन्तमवस्थितम्। महेन्द्र इव धाराभिः शरैरभिववर्ष ह॥
en: And even as the great Indra shower down rain, Akampana showered shafts on Hanuman resembling a mountain-summit in grandeur.

sa: उग्रदर्शनकर्माणो बहवस्तत्र दस्यवः। आभीरप्रमुखाः पापाः पिबन्ति सलिलं मम॥
en: There are there many robbers of ferocious forms and actions, wicked wights, headed bycow-herds, who drink of my water.

sa: राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातो मातलिः शक्रसारथिः॥ दिव्यं तं रथमास्थाय दिवमेवोत्पपात ह।
en: And being commanded by Rāghava Mātali, the charioteer of Sakra taking the celestial car, rose up in the welkin.

sa: महेन्द्रमथ संप्राप्य रामो राजीवलोचनः। आरुरोह महाबाहुः शिखरं दुमभूषितम्॥
en: And reaching the mount Mahendra, the largearmed Rāma, having eyes like lotuses, ascended the summit adorned with diverse trees.

sa: अथ धौतोपलतलां तोयौधैः सहसोत्थितैः। वेलामासाद्य विपुलां रामो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Reaching the expansive banks having rocks there on and continually washed by the rising billow, Rāma spoke these words.

sa: स लक्ष्मणो रावनसायकार्तश्चचाल चापं शिथिलं प्रगृह्य । पुनश्च संज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य कृच्छ्राच्चिच्छेद चापं त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः॥
en: Laksmana, tortured with Ravan's arrow, shook, loosely holding his bow; and then recovering his consciousness after undergoing extreme agony he severed the bow of the foe of the foremost of celestials.

sa: अस्तं दिनकरे याते रक्षसां निलयं पुरीम्॥ प्रविष्टोऽहमविज्ञातो रक्षोभिर्भीमविक्रमैः।
en: On the sun having set, I entered the city of the Raksasas-their home-unnoticed by the Rākṣasas of terrific vigour.

sa: तान्यौषधान्यानयितुं क्षीरोदं यान्तु सागरम्। जवेन वानराः शीघ्रं संपातिपनसादयः॥
en: Let Sampati, Panasa, and other monkeys speedily hie to the Milky Ocean for the purpose of bringing those medicines.

sa: शोचती च मया दृष्टं प्राकारेणाभिसंवृतम्। काञ्चनेन विकृष्टेन गृहोपवनमुत्तमम्॥
en: As I was sorrowing, I saw as mansion with a charming grove encircled by a wall of excellent gold.

sa: वेलावनमुपागम्य ततस्ते हरिपुङ्गवाः। निविष्टाश्च परं पारं काङ्माणा महोदधेः॥
en: There upon, reaching the shore, those leading monkeys engaged in concerning a plan to cross over the vastly deep.

sa: तस्य तुष्टोऽभवद्राजा प्रददौ च विभूषणम्। अशोकवनिकायां च सीतादर्शनलालसः॥
en: Thereat, the king, eager to meet with Sītā in the Asoka woods, well-pleased, conferred an excellent ornament on him.

sa: सुवर्णपुङ्खैर्विशिखैः संपतद्भिः समन्ततः। बभूव रजनी चित्रा खद्योतैरिव शारदी॥
en: And with shafts plated with gold lying in all directions the night resembled one in autumn decked with fire-flies.

sa: काकाः श्येनास्तथा नीचा गृध्राः परिपतन्ति च। शिवाश्चाप्यशुभानादानदन्ति सुमहाभयान्॥
en: Crows, and hawks, and the inferior vultures, wheel all round. And jackals are sending inauspicious yells, exciting great fear.

sa: सा तु कृत्वाञ्जलिं दीना कन्योदाच तपोधनम्। न जाने कारणं तात येन मे रूपमीदृशम्॥
en: Thereat, in .woe-begone guise, with joined hands, his daughter replied to that one having asceticism for the riches, 'O father, cause know I none whereby I have come by this appearance.

sa: ततस्तेनैव सहसा सीदन्ति स्म पदातिनः। महापङ्कमिवासाद्य कुञ्जराः षष्टिहायनाः॥
en: Thereupon with the arrows the infantry were greatly exhausted like to young elephants six years old, fallen in mire.

sa: मालिनं विमुखं कृत्वा शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः। मालिमौलिं ध्वजं चापं वाजिनश्चाप्यपातयत्॥
en: And baffling Māli, the holder of the conch, discus, and mace, brought down Māli's crown, standard, bow and steeds.

sa: निमित्तानि निमित्तज्ञो दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। सौमित्रिं संपरिष्वज्य इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having seen omens, that one, Laksmina's elder brother, conversant with them, embracing the son of Sumitrā, said these words.

sa: तस्य जाजृम्भमाणस्य वक्रं पातालसंनिभम्। ददृशे मेरुशृङ्गाग्रे दिवाकर इवोदितः॥
en: As he yawned, his mouth resembling the subterraneous regions, looked like the Sun stationed at the summit of Meru.

sa: रावणस्तवसंयुक्तान् गर्जतो राक्षसानपि। राजमार्ग समावृत्य स्थितं रक्षोगणं महत्॥
en: And (Hanumān) saw goblins and Rākşasas storming and eulogizing Rāvana; and mighty swarms of Rākṣas stationed, covering the highway.

sa: स प्रासमाविध्य तदाङ्गदाय समुज्ज्वलन्तं सहसोत्ससर्ज। स वालिपुत्रोरसि वज्रकल्पे बभूव भग्नो न्यपतच्च भूमौ ॥
en: Then whirling his praśa, he suddenly discharged that flaming (weapon) against Argada. And then it was snapped on the breast of Vali's son, resembling the thunder-bolt, and dropped to the earth.

sa: स सागरं दानवपन्नगायुतं बलेन विक्रम्य महोर्मिमालिनम्। निपत्य तारे च महोदयेस्तदा ददर्श लङ्काममरावतीमिव ॥
en: Having by main force bounded over the ocean heaving with surges, and rife with Dānavas and Pannagas, he alighting on the shore of the mighty main, beheld Lankā like to Amarāvati.

sa: ततो रावणदाराश्च रावणश्च महाबलः। तं देशमनुसम्प्राप्तो यत्र सीताभवत्स्थिता॥
en: Then the wives of Rāvana along with Rāvana himself of exceeding strength came to that place where Sītā was.

sa: ततस्ते रावणं युद्धे शरैः पावकसंनिभैः। विमुखीकृत्य संहृष्टा विनेदुर्विविधारवान्॥
en: And turning away Rāvana in the conflict by means of shafts resembling fire, they, exceedingly rejoiced, emitted various shouts.

sa: महोदरे तु निहते महापार्यो महाबलः। सुग्रीवेण समीक्ष्याथ क्रोधात्संरक्तलोचनः॥
en: Mahodara being thus slain by Sugrīva, the highly powerful Mahāpäráva, having his eyes reddened with ire, looked towards him.

sa: लक्ष्मणेन तु तद्वाक्यमुक्तं श्रुत्वा स राघवः। संदधे परवीरघ्नो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्॥ रावणाय शरान्घोरान्विससर्ज चमूमुखे। अथान्यं रथमास्थाय रावणो राक्षसाधिपः॥ अभ्यधावत काकुत्स्थं स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम्।
en: Hearing the words uttered by Lakşmaņa, that slayer of hostile heroes-Raghava-endued with prowess, taking his bow, set shafts on it, and in the brunt of battle began to discharge dreadful arrows at Ravana. And mounted on another car, Rāvana-lord of Rakşasas-rushed against Käkutstha, even as Svarbhānu rush against the Sun.

sa: ततस्ताः सहिताः सर्वा विहताशा निरुद्यमाः। परिक्लिश्य समस्तास्ता निद्रावशमुपागताः॥
en: Then, they all failing in their hope and deprived of energy, and tired, caine under the sway of sleep.

sa: तं विसृज्य ततो रामो वयस्यमकुतोभयम्। प्रतर्दनं काशिपतिं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having bade adieu to his maternal uncle Rāma embraced his friend Pratardana, the undaunted king of Käśī and said.

sa: अहो धिङ् मानुषं लोकं नास्ति खल्वधमः परः। यहुर्बला बलवता भर्तारो रावणेन नः॥ सूर्येणोदयता काले नक्षत्राणीव नाशिताः।
en: Oh! fie upon humanity: there is none more vile than a man for they are weak. As the stars disappear with the rising of the sun in time, so our husbands have been destroyed by the powerful Ravana.

sa: स सागरं दानवपन्नगायुतं बलेन विक्रम्य महोर्मिमालिनम्। निपत्य तारे च महोदयेस्तदा ददर्श लङ्काममरावतीमिव ॥
en: Having by main force bounded over the ocean heaving with surges, and rife with Dānavas and Pannagas, he alighting on the shore of the mighty main, beheld Lankā like to Amarāvati.

sa: हतवीरप्रधाना हि गतोत्साहा निरुद्यमा। सेना भ्रमति संख्येषु हतकणेव नौ ले॥ इयं पुनरसंभ्रान्ता निरुद्विग्ना तपस्विनि। सेना रक्षति काकुत्स्थौ मया प्रीत्या निवेदितौ ॥
en: An army that has its heroes and chiefs slainbecoming dispirited and drooping, range the field, like a vessel on water that has losi its helmsman. But, O lorm one, these troops, be trying neither agitation nor anxiety, are guarding the Kākutsthas, This I tell you of them out of affection.

sa: तां शरैर्दशभिः क्रुद्धस्ताडयामास राक्षसः॥ विपन्नं कर्म तद् दृष्ट्वा हनूमांश्चण्डविक्रमः। सालं विपुलमुत्पाट्य भ्रामयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: And the enraged Rākṣasa opposed it by ten shafts. Witnessing his action rendered fruitless, the energetic Hanumān of terrific prowess, uprooting a large Sāla, began to whirl it in the air).

sa: महता हि शरौघेण राक्षसो रणदुर्मदः। अर्दयामास संक्रुद्धो वानरान्परमाहवे॥
en: In terrific encounter the enraged Rākşasa irresistible in battle drove the monkeys to sore straits with showers of arrows.

sa: तस्याभिवादनं कृत्वा दशग्रीवो निशाचरः। अब्रवीत्कुशलं पृष्ट्वा हेतुमागमनस्य च॥
en: Thereupon saluting him, the night-ranger Tennecked one enquired after his welfare as well as the occasion of his visit.

sa: अथ कुम्भहनुस्तत्र तारेणासाद्य वीर्यवान्। वृक्षेण महता सद्यः प्राणान्संत्याजयद्रणे॥
en: There speedily assailed by Tārā, with a mighty tree, the powerful Kumbhahanu gave up the ghost in the conflict.

sa: तेन त्वं ग्रहणं शत्रोर्यातो नान्येन वासव। शीघ्रं वै यज यज्ञं त्वं वैष्णवं सुसमाहितः॥
en: For that curse and nothing else, O Vasava, you have been brought under the grasp of enemies. Having controlled your senses, do you soon undertake a sacrifice in honour of Vişņu.

sa: एतेन चात्यद्भुतदर्षनानि शरैर्जनस्थानकृतालयानि। चतुर्दशान्यात्तवरायुधानि रक्षः सहस्राणि निषूदितानि ॥
en: By me with my shafts have been slaughtered four and ten thousand Rākṣasa residing in Janasthāna, wielding excellent weapons.

sa: ततो महात्मा विपुलं सुयुग्यं रथं वरं हेमविचित्रताङ्गम्। शुभं समास्थाय ययौ यशस्वी विभीषणः संसदमग्रजस्य॥
en: Then mounting a large, noble and splendid car, having its parts decked with gold, and yoked with horses, the magnanimous and renowned Vibhīşana went to the court of his elder brother.

sa: श्रुत्वा न भेतव्यमिति स्त्रीजनं स तदार्जुनः। उत्ततार जलात्तस्माद्गङ्गातोयादिवाञ्जनः॥
en: Hearing those words and saying to the females-"Do not fear” he rose up from the waters like an elephante

sa: तच्छुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य गर्जितं राघवस्तदा। अभीतवदनः क्रुद्धो रावणिं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the vaunt of the Rākşasa-chief, Rahgu's son, inflamed with rage, with an undaunted countenance, spoke to Ravana's son.

sa: को हि सिंहमिवासीनं सुप्तं गिरिगुहाशये। क्रुद्धं मृत्युमिवासीनं संबोधयितुमिच्छति॥
en: Who wish to address a lion that is lying asleep in a cave, resembling Death wrought up by wrath?

sa: ते सर्वे वानरांश्च राक्षसाश्च महाबलाः। यथासुखमसंबाधं दिव्ये तस्मिन्नुपाविशन्॥
en: All the monkeys, bears and the highly powerful Rákşasas sat in that celestial car unobstructed and at their pleasure.

sa: ततस्त्वद्गात्रशोभीनि रक्षसा ह्रियमाणया॥ यान्याभरणजालानि पातितानि महीतले। तानि सर्वाणि रामाय आनीय हरियूथपाः॥ संहष्टा दर्शयामासुर्गतिं तु न विदुस्तव।
en: And collecting all those ornaments which were thrown off by you on the earth when you were borne away, the leaders of the monkey hosts, delighted brought them before Räma. But they could not make out your whereabouts.

sa: रावणं तु मुमोचाथ स्वकक्षात्कपिसत्तमः। कुतस्त्वमिति चोवाच प्रहसनरावणं मुहुः॥
en: Having got out Răvaņa from his arm-pit, the foremost of monkeys, laughing again and again said:-"Where are you coming?"

sa: सुग्रीवस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा रामो महाबलः। समीपस्थानुवाचेदं हनुमत्प्रमुखान्कपीन्॥
en: And hearing the words of Sugrīva, the mighty Rāma spoke to the monkeys, near him, headed by Hanumān, saying.

sa: ततो मूर्धा निपतितं वानरं वानरर्षभः। दृष्ट्वैवोद्विग्नहृदयो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: And beholding that monkey place his crown at his feet the monkey-chief, with an anxious mind, accosted him, saying.

sa: ददर्श च पतन्नेव विविधदुमभूषितम्। दीपं शाखामृगश्रेष्ठो मलयोपवनानि च॥
en: As he went on, that best of monkeys saw an island decked with diverse trees, and groves pertaining Malaya.

sa: क्रोधमूर्च्छितरूपस्तु धुन्वन्यरमकार्मुकम्। दृष्ट्वा तु कर्म शत्रूणां सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: And transported with passion, he, twanging his mighty bow seeing that feat of his foe, addressed his charioteer saying.

sa: न मत्तो निर्गतान्बाणान्विजिह्वान्पन्नगानिव। रामः पश्यति संग्रामे तेन मामभिगच्छति॥
en: Răma has not seen shafts shot by me, resembling two-tongued serpents, and therefore, it is that he approach me.

sa: संधाय चान्यं सुमुखं शरमाशीविषोपमम्। आजघान महातेजा वक्षसि द्विविदाग्रजम्॥
en: Then aiming other fair-headed arrows resembling venomous snakes, that exceedingly energetic one smote Dvivida's elder brother in the chest.

sa: ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगृह्णन्त वनौकसः। अङ्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनूमांश्च महाकपिः॥
en: All the heroic monkeys, headed by Angada and the great monkey Hanumān, approved highly of the words of Jāmbavān.

sa: स पर्वततटाग्रस्थः पीडयन्पर्वतोत्तमम्। हनूमान्दृश्यते वीरो द्वितीय इव पर्वतः॥
en: Ascending the summit of that mountain,* and hurting it with his tread, that hero-Hanumanappeared like a second mountain. *Trikuta.

sa: ततः प्रज्वालयित्वाग्निं तावुभौ हरीराक्षसौ। भ्रातृत्वमुपसंपन्नौ परिष्वज्य परस्परम् ॥
en: Thereupon having lighted up fire the king of monkeys and the king of Rākşasas, embracing each other, became friends.

sa: वेदेह्यां मां च कुशलं सुग्रीवं च सलक्ष्मणम्। आचक्ष्व वदतां श्रेष्ठ रावणं च हतं रणे॥ प्रियमेतदिहाख्याहि वैदेह्यास्त्वं हरीश्वर। प्रतिगृह्य तु संदेशमुपावर्तितुमर्हसि ॥
en: Do you, O foremost of monkeys, inform Vaidehr of the destruction of Rāvana in conflict after communicating to her mine health as well as that of Lakşmaņa and Sugrīva. O lord of monkeys, it behove you to return with the tidings of Vaidehi after informing her of this pleasant news.

sa: ततो वानरराजेन लक्ष्मणेन सुपूजितः। उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा पुनरप्यर्थकोविदः॥
en: Then honoured by the monkey-king as well as Lakşmaņa, the righteous Rāma, understanding the import of things, again said.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा हनूमन्तं स जाम्बवान्। आगच्छ हरिशार्दूल वानरांस्त्रातुमर्हसि ॥
en: Then that exceedingly energetic Jåmbavān addressed Hanumān, saying, “Come, O powerful monkey, It behove you to rescue the monkeys."

sa: श्रुत्वा हनूमतो वाक्यं तदा विव्यथितेन्द्रियः। पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्यते प्लवगोत्तमः॥
en: Hearing Hanuman's voice, that foremost of monkeys with his senses sorely smarting, deemed himself as having regained his life.

sa: तद्गच्छ कुरु साहाय्यं स्वबलेनाभिसंवृतः। क्षिप्रमृक्षपते तस्य कपिश्रेष्ठस्य युध्यतः॥
en: Do you therefore proceed speedily, O lord of bears, with all your soldiers to assist that foremost of monkeys.

sa: विषण्णवदनं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसं हरियूथपाः। ततः परमसंहृष्टा लक्ष्मणं चाभ्यपूजयन्॥
en: Seeing the Rākşasa with his face fallen, the leaders of monkey-hands, were exceedingly delighted and rendered homage to Lakşmaņa.

sa: ततो यानगतां सीतां सविमर्श विचारयन्। विभीषणमिदं वाक्यमहष्टो राघवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Considering Sīta who was in the palanquin, over whelmed with grief, Raghava delighted addressed Vibhīşaņa with the following words.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महेन्द्रस्य कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः। निष्कृष्यरावताहन्तं जघानोरसि वासवम्॥
en: Thereat, enraged with the great Indra, the mighty Kumbhakarņa plucking a tusk of Airāvata, hurled it at Vāsava's chest.

sa: तदहं स्वेण रूपेण रजन्यां ह्रस्वतां गतः। लङ्कामभिपतिष्यामि राघवस्यार्थसिद्धये॥
en: Therefore, diminishing myself, I shall at night, for compassing the welfare of Rāghava, enter Lankā is my own form.

sa: तेनाहं प्रेषितो दूतस्त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः॥ त्वद्वियोगेन दुःखार्तः स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत्। लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजाः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः॥ अभिवाद्य महाबाहुः स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत्।
en: I have been sent by him as a messenger to you. Worn with grief in your separation he has enquired of your welfare, as well the highly effulgent Lakşmaņa, the enhancer of Sumitrā's joy, bowing reverentially to you.

sa: मालां ज्वलन्तीं वपुषा काञ्चनीं शतपुष्कराम्॥ राघवाय ददौ वायुर्वासवेन प्रचोदितः। सर्वरत्नसमायुक्तं मणिभिश्च विभूषितम्।७०।। मुक्ताहारं नरेन्द्राय ददौ शक्रप्रचोदितः।
en: The wind commanded by Väsava conferred upon Rāghava, a garland or hundred golden lotuses, shining in their native lustre. And the wind commanded by Sakra conferred upon that lord of men a jewelled garland crested with diverse gems.

sa: भग्नांस्तु तान्समालक्ष्य यक्षेन्द्रांस्तु महाबलान्। धनाध्यक्षो महाबाहुः प्रेषयामास यक्षकान्॥
en: And finding the foremost Yakşas endowed with great strength give way, the mighty-armed lord of riches despatched (other) Yaksas.

sa: नरान्तकं हतं दृष्ट्वा चुक्रुशुनैऋतषर्भाः। देवान्तकरित्रमूर्धा च पौलस्त्यश्च महोदरः॥
en: Seeing Narāntaka slain, the foremost of Naiſtas-including the three-headed Devāntaka and Pulastya's descendant, Mahodara, began to cry (in chorus).

sa: अन्योन्यं बद्धवैराणां घोराणां जयमिच्छताम्। संप्रवृत्तं निशायुद्धं तदा वानररक्षसाम्॥
en: Then commenced a night-engagement between the dreadful Rākşasas and the monkeys of fixed hostility, each party burning for victory.

sa: क्रोधदूषितनेवस्तु स तदार्जुनपावकः। प्रजज्वाल महाघोरो युगान्त इव पावकः॥
en: The eyes of that fire-like Arjuna were reddened with ire and he shone dreadfully like the fire of dissolution.

sa: रुरोद सहसा सीता मन्दमन्दस्वरा सती। साऽथ दृष्ट्वा हरिवरं विनीतवदुपागतम्। थिली चिन्तयामास स्वप्नोऽयमिति भामिनी॥
en: She wept silently and lowly. And then beholding that best of monkeys approach her humbly, the fair daughter of the Mithila's king, thought, "Is this a dream mine eyes have seen?”

sa: अपूजयत्कर्म स लक्ष्मणस्य सुदुष्करं दाशरथिर्महात्मा। बभूव हृष्टो युधि वानरेन्द्रो निशम्य तं शक्रजितं निपातितम्॥
en: The high-souled son of Dasaratha honoured exceedingly that exceedingly hard feat of Laks amana; and the monkey-king, hearing that the conqueror of Sakra had fallen in fight, was filled with joy.
